요구 조건 @link[equipment.healers-toolkit] 착용 또는 소지

당신은 질병에 걸린 크리처를 최소 8시간 동안 돌봅니다. 질병의 DC를 상대로 의술 판정을 시도합니다. 어떤 크리처에게 질병 치료를 시도한 후에는, 그 크리처가 해당 질병에 대해 다음 내성 판정을 할 때까지 다시 시도할 수 없습니다.

대성공 그 크리처는 해당 질병에 대한 다음 내성 판정에 +4 상황 보너스를 받습니다.

성공 그 크리처는 해당 질병에 대한 다음 내성 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 받습니다.

대실패 당신의 노력으로 인해 그 크리처는 해당 질병에 대한 다음 내성 판정에 −2 상황 페널티를 받습니다.

name: Unravel the Future

description.value: You pluck a single thread from your ikon, which ties itself in three loops about your wrist, where it remains for the next minute. If you fail an attack roll or skill check, and a +1 status bonus would change your failure into a success or your success into a critical success, you gain a +1 status bonus to this check retroactively, changing the outcome appropriately as the thread pulls you to the future you desire. The thread then falls from your wrist. You can have only one thread in existence at a time.

publication.title: Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea

_desc_en: You pluck a single thread from your ikon, which ties itself in three loops about your wrist, where it remains for the next minute. If you fail an attack roll or skill check, and a +1 status bonus would change your failure into a success or your success into a critical success, you gain a +1 status bonus to this check retroactively, changing the outcome appropriately as the thread pulls you to the future you desire. The thread then falls from your wrist. You can have only one thread in existence at a time.
_desc_ko: 당신은 자신의 이콘에서 실 한 가닥을 뽑아내고, 그 실은 당신의 손목에 세 겹의 고리로 스스로를 묶은 채 다음 1분 동안 그대로 남아 있습니다. 당신이 명중 굴림이나 기술 판정에 실패하고, +1 상태 보너스가 있었다면 실패가 성공으로 또는 성공이 대성공으로 바뀔 상황이라면, 당신은 이 판정에 소급하여 +1 상태 보너스를 얻어, 실이 당신을 원하는 미래로 끌어당기면서 결과를 그에 맞게 바꿉니다. 그런 다음 실은 당신의 손목에서 떨어집니다. 당신은 한 번에 실을 하나만 존재하게 할 수 있습니다.

name: Fey's Fortune

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You attempt a skill check and haven't yet rolled

Effect Roll the skill check twice and use the better result

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You attempt a skill check and haven't yet rolled

Effect Roll the skill check twice and use the better result
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루 1회

발동 조건 당신이 기술 판정을 시도하며 아직 굴리지 않았을 때

효과 기술 판정을 두 번 굴려 더 나은 결과를 사용합니다.

name: Energy Shot

description.value:
Trigger You roll initiative.

You unleash a small surge of magical energy into your weapon, shrouding the bullet with potential energy and granting it the ability to deal energy damage to your foes to exploit their weaknesses. You can Interact to draw a ranged weapon. On your first three Strikes of this encounter with a firearm or crossbow, you deal an additional 1 acid, cold, fire or electricity damage per weapon damage die. You choose which damage type to deal as part of making each Strike.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.zocU4IYIlWwRKUuE]{Effect: Energy Shot}

_desc_en:
Trigger You roll initiative.

You unleash a small surge of magical energy into your weapon, shrouding the bullet with potential energy and granting it the ability to deal energy damage to your foes to exploit their weaknesses. You can Interact to draw a ranged weapon. On your first three Strikes of this encounter with a firearm or crossbow, you deal an additional 1 acid, cold, fire or electricity damage per weapon damage die. You choose which damage type to deal as part of making each Strike.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.zocU4IYIlWwRKUuE]{Effect: Energy Shot}
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이 우선권을 굴립니다.

당신은 자신의 무기에 작은 마법 에너지의 파동을 방출하여, 탄환을 잠재 에너지로 감싸 적의 약점을 파고들 에너지 피해를 입히는 능력을 부여합니다. 당신은 상호작용하여 원거리 무기를 뽑을 수 있습니다. 이 조우에서 화기 또는 석궁으로 처음 세 번의 타격에서, 당신은 무기 피해 주사위당 1 산성, 냉기, 화염 또는 전기 피해를 추가로 입힙니다. 각 타격을 할 때 어떤 피해 유형을 입힐지는 그 일부로서 당신이 선택합니다.

name: Bullying Press

description.value:
Trigger You attempt a melee Strike against your opponent, but haven't rolled yet.

Requirements You're in a duel, you're trained in Intimidation, and you rolled an Intimidation check for initiative this round.

If you hit, your opponent becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. If your opponent is using Perception for initiative when this ability is used, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} instead.

_desc_en:
Trigger You attempt a melee Strike against your opponent, but haven't rolled yet.

Requirements You're in a duel, you're trained in Intimidation, and you rolled an Intimidation check for initiative this round.

If you hit, your opponent becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. If your opponent is using Perception for initiative when this ability is used, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} instead.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신이 상대에게 근접 타격을 시도하지만 아직 굴리지 않았을 때.

요구 조건 당신이 결투 중이며, 위협에 숙련되어 있고, 이번 라운드에 우선권으로 위협 판정을 굴렸어야 합니다.

명중하면 당신의 상대는 @link[conditions.frightened]{1}이 됩니다. 이 능력을 사용할 때 상대가 우선권으로 감지를 사용하고 있었다면, 대신 @link[conditions.frightened]{2}가 됩니다.

name: Search

description.value: You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} meticulously for hidden doors, concealed hazards, and so on. You can usually make an educated guess as to which locations are best to check and move at half speed, but if you want to be thorough and guarantee you checked everything, you need to travel at a Speed of no more than 300 feet per minute, or 150 feet per minute to ensure you check everything before you walk into it. You can always move more slowly while Searching to cover the area more thoroughly, and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GdZLxDtFXaQI3Fop]{Expeditious Search} feat increases these maximum Speeds. If you come across a secret door, item, or hazard while Searching, the GM will attempt a free secret check to Seek to see if you notice the hidden object or hazard. In locations with many objects to search, you have to stop and spend significantly longer to search thoroughly.

_desc_en: You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} meticulously for hidden doors, concealed hazards, and so on. You can usually make an educated guess as to which locations are best to check and move at half speed, but if you want to be thorough and guarantee you checked everything, you need to travel at a Speed of no more than 300 feet per minute, or 150 feet per minute to ensure you check everything before you walk into it. You can always move more slowly while Searching to cover the area more thoroughly, and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.GdZLxDtFXaQI3Fop]{Expeditious Search} feat increases these maximum Speeds. If you come across a secret door, item, or hazard while Searching, the GM will attempt a free secret check to Seek to see if you notice the hidden object or hazard. In locations with many objects to search, you have to stop and spend significantly longer to search thoroughly.
_desc_ko: 당신은 숨겨진 문, 은폐된 위험 등을 찾기 위해 꼼꼼하게 @link[actions.seek]합니다. 당신은 보통 어느 위치를 확인하는 것이 가장 좋을지 어느 정도 추측하며 절반 속도로 이동할 수 있지만, 철저히 하여 모든 곳을 확인했음을 보장하려면 분당 300피트 이하의 속도로 이동해야 하며, 무언가에 들어서기 전에 모든 것을 확인하려면 분당 150피트로 이동해야 합니다. 당신은 탐색하는 동안 그 지역을 더 철저히 살피기 위해 언제든 더 느리게 이동할 수 있으며, @link[feats.expeditious-search] 재주는 이 최대 속도를 증가시킵니다. 탐색하는 동안 비밀 문, 아이템 또는 위험을 마주치면, GM은 당신이 숨겨진 물체나 위험을 알아차리는지 확인하기 위해 무료 비밀 탐색 판정을 시도합니다. 수색할 물체가 많은 장소에서는 멈춰서 철저히 수색하기 위해 상당히 더 오랜 시간을 들여야 합니다.

name: Crawl

description.value:
Requirements You are prone and your Speed is at least 10 feet.

You move 5 feet by crawling and continue to stay @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

_desc_en:
Requirements You are prone and your Speed is at least 10 feet.

You move 5 feet by crawling and continue to stay @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
_desc_ko:
요구 조건 당신이 넘어져 있고 당신의 속도가 최소 10피트입니다.

당신은 기어서 5피트를 이동하며 계속 @link[conditions.prone] 상태를 유지합니다.

name: One Shot, One Kill

description.value:
Trigger You roll Stealth for initiative.

Your first shot is the deadliest. Interact to draw a firearm or crossbow. Your first successful Strike with that weapon during this encounter deals an additional 1d6 precision damage. This precision damage increases to 2d6 at 9th level and 3d6 at 15th level.

_desc_en:
Trigger You roll Stealth for initiative.

Your first shot is the deadliest. Interact to draw a firearm or crossbow. Your first successful Strike with that weapon during this encounter deals an additional 1d6 precision damage. This precision damage increases to 2d6 at 9th level and 3d6 at 15th level.
_desc_ko:
기폭 조건 우선권을 위해 은신 판정을 굴립니다.

당신의 첫 발이 가장 치명적입니다. 상호작용으로 화기 또는 석궁을 뽑습니다. 이번 조우 중 그 무기로 처음 성공한 타격은 추가로 1d6 정밀 피해를 입힙니다. 이 정밀 피해는 9레벨에 2d6, 15레벨에 3d6으로 증가합니다.

name: Affix a Talisman

description.value:
Requirements You must use a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.vLGDUFrg4yGzpTQX]{Repair Toolkit}

You spend 10 minutes affixing a talisman to an item, placing the item on a stable surface and using the repair toolkit with both hands. You can also use this activity to remove a talisman. Attaching more than one talisman to an item deactivates all the talismans. They must be removed and re-affixed before they can be used again.

_desc_en:
Requirements You must use a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.vLGDUFrg4yGzpTQX]{Repair Toolkit}

You spend 10 minutes affixing a talisman to an item, placing the item on a stable surface and using the repair toolkit with both hands. You can also use this activity to remove a talisman. Attaching more than one talisman to an item deactivates all the talismans. They must be removed and re-affixed before they can be used again.
_desc_ko:
요구 조건 @link[equipment.repair-toolkit]을 사용해야 합니다.

당신은 10분에 걸쳐 부적을 아이템에 부착하며, 아이템을 안정된 표면 위에 놓고 두 손으로 수리 도구함을 사용합니다. 이 활동을 사용해 부적을 제거할 수도 있습니다. 한 아이템에 부적을 두 개 이상 부착하면 모든 부적이 비활성화됩니다. 다시 사용하려면 부적들을 제거하고 재부착해야 합니다.

name: Fire in the Hole

description.value:
Trigger A creature moves into the hazard's space

Effect The hazard explodes, dealing the bombs' damage and splash damage to the inanimate object. Combine this damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses, and this damage ignores an amount of the object's Hardness equal to your level. Any creatures adjacent to the hazard take the bombs' splash damage, similarly combined for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses. As a reminder, since you didn't throw the bombs, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UjWLK86BgHxz3Itd]{Calculated Splash} and similar effects don't apply.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature moves into the hazard's space

Effect The hazard explodes, dealing the bombs' damage and splash damage to the inanimate object. Combine this damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses, and this damage ignores an amount of the object's Hardness equal to your level. Any creatures adjacent to the hazard take the bombs' splash damage, similarly combined for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses. As a reminder, since you didn't throw the bombs, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UjWLK86BgHxz3Itd]{Calculated Splash} and similar effects don't apply.
_desc_ko:
기폭 조건 어떤 크리처가 이 위험물의 공간으로 이동합니다.

효과 위험물이 폭발하여 폭탄들의 피해와 비산 피해를 무생물 대상에게 입힙니다. 저항과 취약성을 계산할 때 이 피해를 합산하며, 이 피해는 대상의 경도 중 당신의 레벨과 같은 양을 무시합니다. 위험물에 인접한 모든 크리처는 폭탄들의 비산 피해를 받으며, 마찬가지로 저항과 취약성을 계산할 때 합산합니다. 참고로, 당신이 폭탄을 던진 것이 아니므로 @link[feats.calculated-splash] 및 유사한 효과는 적용되지 않습니다.

name: Step

description.value:
Requirements Your Speed is at least 10 feet.

You carefully move 5 feet. Unlike most types of movement, Stepping doesn't trigger reactions, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{Reactive Strike}, that can be triggered by move actions or upon leaving or entering a square.

You can't Step into difficult terrain, and you can't Step using a Speed other than your land Speed.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your Speed is at least 10 feet.

You carefully move 5 feet. Unlike most types of movement, Stepping doesn't trigger reactions, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KAVf7AmRnbCAHrkT]{Reactive Strike}, that can be triggered by move actions or upon leaving or entering a square.

You can't Step into difficult terrain, and you can't Step using a Speed other than your land Speed.
_desc_ko:
요구 조건 당신의 속도가 최소 10피트입니다.

당신은 조심스럽게 5피트를 이동합니다. 대부분의 이동 유형과 달리, 발놀림은 이동 행동에 의해 또는 칸을 떠나거나 들어설 때 촉발될 수 있는 @link[actions.reactive-strike]과 같은 반응을 촉발하지 않습니다.

발놀림으로 험지에 들어설 수 없으며, 지상 속도가 아닌 다른 속도를 사용해 발놀림할 수 없습니다.

name: Defensive Retreat

description.value: You call for a careful retreat. Signal all squadmates within the aura of your banner; each can immediately Step up to three times as a free action. Each Step must take them farther away from at least one hostile creature they are observing and can only take them closer to a hostile creature if doing so is the only way for them to move toward safety (such as if they're surrounded).

_desc_en: You call for a careful retreat. Signal all squadmates within the aura of your banner; each can immediately Step up to three times as a free action. Each Step must take them farther away from at least one hostile creature they are observing and can only take them closer to a hostile creature if doing so is the only way for them to move toward safety (such as if they're surrounded).
_desc_ko: 당신은 신중한 후퇴를 명령합니다. 당신 군기의 오라 안에 있는 모든 분대원에게 신호를 보냅니다. 각자는 즉시 자유 행동으로 최대 세 번 발놀림할 수 있습니다. 각 발놀림은 그들이 발각하고 있는 적대적 크리처 중 최소 하나로부터 더 멀어지게 해야 하며, 안전한 곳으로 이동하는 유일한 방법일 때(예: 그들이 포위되어 있을 때)에만 적대적 크리처에게 더 가까워질 수 있습니다.

name: Gather to Me!

description.value:
You signal your team to move into position together. Signal all squadmates; each can immediately Stride as a reaction, though each must end their movement inside your banner's aura, or as close to your banner's aura as their movement Speed allows.

Squadmates can use Gather to Me! while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if they have the corresponding movement type.

_desc_en:
You signal your team to move into position together. Signal all squadmates; each can immediately Stride as a reaction, though each must end their movement inside your banner's aura, or as close to your banner's aura as their movement Speed allows.

Squadmates can use Gather to Me! while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if they have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko:
당신은 함께 자리를 잡으라고 팀에게 신호합니다. 모든 분대원에게 신호를 보냅니다. 각자는 즉시 반응으로 이동할 수 있으나, 각자는 이동을 당신 군기의 오라 안에서 끝내거나, 자신의 이동 속도가 허용하는 한 당신 군기의 오라에 최대한 가깝게 끝내야 합니다.

분대원은 해당하는 이동 유형을 지니고 있다면 이동 대신 굴착, 등반, 비행 또는 수영을 하면서 내게로!를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: Avert Gaze

description.value: You avert your gaze from danger, such as a medusa's gaze. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against visual abilities that require you to look at a creature or object, such as a medusa's petrifying gaze. Your gaze remains averted until the start of your next turn.

_desc_en: You avert your gaze from danger, such as a medusa's gaze. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against visual abilities that require you to look at a creature or object, such as a medusa's petrifying gaze. Your gaze remains averted until the start of your next turn.
_desc_ko: 당신은 메두사의 시선과 같은 위험으로부터 시선을 돌립니다. 메두사의 석화 시선처럼 크리처나 물체를 바라보아야 하는 시각 능력에 대한 내성에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다. 당신의 시선은 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 돌려진 상태로 유지됩니다.

name: Invigorating Fear

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger A creature within 60 feet gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition.

You are invigorated by the shock of a prank or the thrum of terror. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the creature's level or 3, whichever is higher. You lose any temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger A creature within 60 feet gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition.

You are invigorated by the shock of a prank or the thrum of terror. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the creature's level or 3, whichever is higher. You lose any temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 시간당 1회

기폭 조건 60피트 이내의 크리처가 @link[conditions.frightened] 상태이상을 얻습니다.

당신은 장난의 충격이나 공포의 전율에 활력을 얻습니다. 당신은 그 크리처의 레벨과 3 중 더 높은 값과 같은 임시 HP를 얻습니다. 1분이 지나면 임시 HP를 모두 잃습니다.

name: Into the Fray

description.value:
Trigger You roll initiative.

You know trouble can lurk around every corner, and your hands never stray far from your holsters. You can Interact to draw a one-handed ranged weapon and can then Interact to draw a one-handed melee weapon. As your first action on your first turn, you can Stride as a free action toward an enemy you can perceive. If you can't perceive any enemies or can't end your movement closer to one, you can't use this Stride.

_desc_en:
Trigger You roll initiative.

You know trouble can lurk around every corner, and your hands never stray far from your holsters. You can Interact to draw a one-handed ranged weapon and can then Interact to draw a one-handed melee weapon. As your first action on your first turn, you can Stride as a free action toward an enemy you can perceive. If you can't perceive any enemies or can't end your movement closer to one, you can't use this Stride.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 우선권을 굴립니다.

당신은 모퉁이마다 위험이 도사릴 수 있음을 알기에, 두 손은 결코 권총집에서 멀리 떨어지지 않습니다. 상호작용하여 한손 원거리 무기를 뽑을 수 있고, 이어서 상호작용하여 한손 근접 무기를 뽑을 수 있습니다. 첫 턴의 첫 행동으로, 당신이 인지할 수 있는 적을 향해 자유 행동으로 이동할 수 있습니다. 어떤 적도 인지할 수 없거나 이동을 마쳤을 때 적에게 더 가까워질 수 없다면, 이 이동을 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: Sustain an Effect

description.value: You Sustain one effect with a sustained duration while moving at half speed. Most such effects can be sustained for 10 minutes, though some specify they can be sustained for a different duration. Sustaining an effect that requires making complex decisions, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPu3UE3kTXSLqO40]{Spiritual Armament}, can make you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, as determined by the GM.

_desc_en: You Sustain one effect with a sustained duration while moving at half speed. Most such effects can be sustained for 10 minutes, though some specify they can be sustained for a different duration. Sustaining an effect that requires making complex decisions, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPu3UE3kTXSLqO40]{Spiritual Armament}, can make you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, as determined by the GM.
_desc_ko: 절반 속도로 이동하면서 지속 유지 시간을 가진 효과 하나를 유지합니다. 대부분의 이러한 효과는 10분 동안 유지할 수 있으나, 일부는 다른 유지 시간을 명시합니다. @link[spells.spiritual-armament]처럼 복잡한 판단을 요구하는 효과를 유지하면, GM의 판단에 따라 @link[conditions.fatigued] 상태가 될 수 있습니다.

name: Wind Them Up

description.value: Should foes parry your blade or dodge your bullets? Neither—they should be watching their purse. Make a melee Strike with your combination weapon, and then attempt a Thievery check with a –5 penalty to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} from your target; you can't Steal closely guarded objects or objects that would take a long time to pilfer. You don't need a free hand to attempt to Steal something in this manner. If your Thievery check succeeds, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your ranged attacks until the start of your next turn, and you don't trigger reactions that are normally triggered by movement or a ranged attack. These effects occur even if your target has no objects to Steal.

_desc_en: Should foes parry your blade or dodge your bullets? Neither—they should be watching their purse. Make a melee Strike with your combination weapon, and then attempt a Thievery check with a –5 penalty to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Steal} from your target; you can't Steal closely guarded objects or objects that would take a long time to pilfer. You don't need a free hand to attempt to Steal something in this manner. If your Thievery check succeeds, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against your ranged attacks until the start of your next turn, and you don't trigger reactions that are normally triggered by movement or a ranged attack. These effects occur even if your target has no objects to Steal.
_desc_ko: 적들이 당신의 칼날을 막거나 총알을 피해야 할까요? 아닙니다. 그들은 자기 지갑을 지켜야 합니다. 콤비네이션 무기로 근접 타격을 가한 뒤, 대상에게서 @link[actions.steal]를 시도하기 위해 –5 페널티를 받고 도둑기술 판정을 시도합니다. 단, 삼엄하게 지켜지는 물건이나 훔쳐내는 데 오랜 시간이 걸리는 물건은 훔칠 수 없습니다. 이런 방식으로 물건을 훔치는 데에는 빈 손이 필요하지 않습니다. 도둑기술 판정에 성공하면, 대상은 당신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 당신의 원거리 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태가 되며, 당신은 통상적으로 이동이나 원거리 공격에 의해 유발되는 반응행동을 유발하지 않습니다. 이 효과들은 대상이 훔칠 물건을 전혀 가지고 있지 않더라도 발생합니다.

name: Embrace of Destiny

description.value: Choose an enemy within 20 feet of you. It must succeed at a @Check[will|against:exemplar] save against your class DC or be pulled directly toward you into a square adjacent to you.

_desc_en: Choose an enemy within 20 feet of you. It must succeed at a @Check[will|against:exemplar] save against your class DC or be pulled directly toward you into a square adjacent to you.
_desc_ko: 당신으로부터 20피트 이내의 적 하나를 선택합니다. 그 적은 당신의 클래스 DC에 대해 의지 내성에 성공해야 하며, 실패하면 당신을 향해 곧장 끌려와 당신과 인접한 칸으로 이동합니다.

name: Accept Echo

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Effect You allow the echo to inhabit your body, gaining a glowing aura around you, shining pale-green irises, a resonating voice, and the silhouette of the spirit around your own body, all of which can be seen clearly by others. While in this state, you become trained in the weapon you chose and an expert in the skill you chose. Additionally, while you're in this state, the echo can speak and interact with the Universe using your body, and you gain a +4 status bonus to all saves against possession effects, as the possessing spirit protects you from other possessions.

This state lasts for 10 minutes, after which the echo disappears completely until the next time you make your daily preparations. You can Dismiss this effect.

At 7th level you become a master of the skill you chose, at 13th level you become an expert with the weapon you chose, and at 15th level you become legendary with the skill you chose.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Effect You allow the echo to inhabit your body, gaining a glowing aura around you, shining pale-green irises, a resonating voice, and the silhouette of the spirit around your own body, all of which can be seen clearly by others. While in this state, you become trained in the weapon you chose and an expert in the skill you chose. Additionally, while you're in this state, the echo can speak and interact with the Universe using your body, and you gain a +4 status bonus to all saves against possession effects, as the possessing spirit protects you from other possessions.

This state lasts for 10 minutes, after which the echo disappears completely until the next time you make your daily preparations. You can Dismiss this effect.

At 7th level you become a master of the skill you chose, at 13th level you become an expert with the weapon you chose, and at 15th level you become legendary with the skill you chose.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루 1회

효과 당신은 에코가 당신의 몸에 깃들도록 허락하여, 몸 주위에 빛나는 오라, 창백한 녹색으로 빛나는 홍채, 울려 퍼지는 목소리, 그리고 자기 몸 주위로 드리운 영혼의 실루엣을 얻으며, 이 모든 것은 다른 이들에게 뚜렷이 보입니다. 이 상태에 있는 동안, 당신은 선택한 무기에 숙련되고 선택한 기술에 전문가가 됩니다. 또한 이 상태에 있는 동안, 에코는 당신의 몸을 사용하여 말하고 우주와 상호작용할 수 있으며, 깃든 영혼이 다른 빙의로부터 당신을 보호하므로 당신은 모든 빙의 효과에 대한 내성에 +4 상태 보너스를 받습니다.

이 상태는 10분 동안 지속되며, 그 후 에코는 당신이 다음번 일일 준비를 할 때까지 완전히 사라집니다. 당신은 이 효과를 무효화할 수 있습니다.

7레벨에 당신은 선택한 기술의 달인이 되고, 13레벨에 선택한 무기의 전문가가 되며, 15레벨에 선택한 기술의 전설이 됩니다.

name: Patron's Presence

description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Effect A palpable weight extends from your familiar in a @Template[emanation|distance:15]. Enemies who enter or start their turn within the aura must succeed at a Will save against your spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} as long as they remain within the aura, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} on a critical failure. The aura lasts until the end of your next turn, but the familiar can Sustain it up to 1 minute.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per hour

Effect A palpable weight extends from your familiar in a @Template[emanation|distance:15]. Enemies who enter or start their turn within the aura must succeed at a Will save against your spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} as long as they remain within the aura, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} on a critical failure. The aura lasts until the end of your next turn, but the familiar can Sustain it up to 1 minute.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 시간당 1회

효과 뚜렷이 느껴지는 무게감이 당신의 사역마로부터 15피트 발산으로 퍼져 나갑니다. 이 오라 안으로 들어오거나 오라 안에서 턴을 시작하는 적은 당신의 주문 DC에 대해 의지 내성에 성공해야 하며, 실패하면 오라 안에 머무는 동안 @link[conditions.stupefied]{2} 상태가 되고, 대실패 시에는 @link[conditions.stupefied]{3} 상태가 됩니다. 오라는 당신의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 지속되지만, 사역마가 최대 1분까지 이를 유지할 수 있습니다.

name: Sever Conduit

description.value:
Trigger Your eidolon takes damage that would bring you to 0 Hit Points and comes from an effect other than a death effect

Effect You quickly shut the buffer in your link with your eidolon, causing your bonded ally to wink out of existence before you can be laid low. Your eidolon unmanifests, and you can't Manifest your Eidolon for 1 minute. In exchange, you don't take the triggering damage, though your eidolon still suffers any other adverse effects that accompanied the damage.

_desc_en:
Trigger Your eidolon takes damage that would bring you to 0 Hit Points and comes from an effect other than a death effect

Effect You quickly shut the buffer in your link with your eidolon, causing your bonded ally to wink out of existence before you can be laid low. Your eidolon unmanifests, and you can't Manifest your Eidolon for 1 minute. In exchange, you don't take the triggering damage, though your eidolon still suffers any other adverse effects that accompanied the damage.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 당신의 에이돌론이 당신을 0 HP로 만들 피해를 입으며, 그 피해가 죽음 효과가 아닌 다른 효과에서 비롯됩니다

효과 당신은 에이돌론과의 연결에서 완충 지대를 재빨리 닫아, 당신이 쓰러지기 전에 유대를 맺은 아군을 존재하지 않는 상태로 사라지게 만듭니다. 당신의 에이돌론은 현신을 거두며, 당신은 1분 동안 에이돌론을 현신시킬 수 없습니다. 그 대가로 당신은 발동 조건이 된 피해를 입지 않으나, 에이돌론은 그 피해에 수반된 다른 악영향은 여전히 겪습니다.

name: Guerrilla Assault

description.value:
Frequency once per round

Effect You Interact to reload a sling or blowgun and then Strike. If the Strike is successful and you were undetected or unnoticed by the target when you made the attack, you are now @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from the target after the attack, as they cannot tell where the attack came from.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per round

Effect You Interact to reload a sling or blowgun and then Strike. If the Strike is successful and you were undetected or unnoticed by the target when you made the attack, you are now @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from the target after the attack, as they cannot tell where the attack came from.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 라운드당 1회

효과 당신은 상호작용하여 투석구나 취관을 재장전한 뒤 타격을 가합니다. 타격이 성공했고 당신이 공격했을 때 대상에게 발각되지 않았거나 인지되지 않은 상태였다면, 공격이 어디서 왔는지 대상이 알 수 없으므로 당신은 공격 이후 대상에게 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태가 됩니다.

name: Sneak

description.value:
You attempt to move to another place while becoming or staying undetected. Stride up to half your Speed. (You can use Sneak while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type; you must move at half that Speed.)

At the end of your movement, the GM rolls your [[/act sneak]] check in secret and compares the result to the Perception DC of each creature you were @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by at the start of your movement. If you have cover or greater cover from the creature throughout your Stride, you gain the +2 circumstance bonus from cover (or +4 from greater cover) to your Stealth check. Because you're moving, the bonus increase from Taking Cover doesn't apply. You don't get to roll against a creature if, at the end of your movement, you neither are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from it nor have cover or greater cover against it. You automatically become observed by such a creature.

Success You're undetected by the creature during your movement and remain undetected by the creature at the end of it.

You become observed as soon as you do anything other than Hide, Sneak, or Step. If you attempt to Strike a creature, the creature remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against that attack, and you then become observed. If you do anything else, you become observed just before you act unless the GM determines otherwise. The GM might allow you to perform a particularly unobtrusive action without being noticed, possibly requiring another Stealth check. If you speak or make a deliberate loud noise, you become hidden instead of undetected.

If a creature uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} and you become hidden to it as a result, you must Sneak if you want to become undetected by that creature again.

Failure A telltale sound or other sign gives your position away, though you still remain unseen. You're hidden from the creature throughout your movement and remain so.

Critical Failure You're spotted! You're observed by the creature throughout your movement and remain so. If you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} and were hidden from the creature, instead of being observed you're hidden throughout your movement and remain so.

_desc_en:
You attempt to move to another place while becoming or staying undetected. Stride up to half your Speed. (You can use Sneak while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type; you must move at half that Speed.)

At the end of your movement, the GM rolls your [[/act sneak]] check in secret and compares the result to the Perception DC of each creature you were @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by at the start of your movement. If you have cover or greater cover from the creature throughout your Stride, you gain the +2 circumstance bonus from cover (or +4 from greater cover) to your Stealth check. Because you're moving, the bonus increase from Taking Cover doesn't apply. You don't get to roll against a creature if, at the end of your movement, you neither are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from it nor have cover or greater cover against it. You automatically become observed by such a creature.

Success You're undetected by the creature during your movement and remain undetected by the creature at the end of it.

You become observed as soon as you do anything other than Hide, Sneak, or Step. If you attempt to Strike a creature, the creature remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against that attack, and you then become observed. If you do anything else, you become observed just before you act unless the GM determines otherwise. The GM might allow you to perform a particularly unobtrusive action without being noticed, possibly requiring another Stealth check. If you speak or make a deliberate loud noise, you become hidden instead of undetected.

If a creature uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} and you become hidden to it as a result, you must Sneak if you want to become undetected by that creature again.

Failure A telltale sound or other sign gives your position away, though you still remain unseen. You're hidden from the creature throughout your movement and remain so.

Critical Failure You're spotted! You're observed by the creature throughout your movement and remain so. If you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} and were hidden from the creature, instead of being observed you're hidden throughout your movement and remain so.
_desc_ko:
발각되지 않거나 발각되지 않은 상태를 유지하면서 다른 장소로 이동을 시도합니다. 자신의 속도의 절반까지 이동합니다. (해당하는 이동 유형을 갖추고 있다면 이동 대신 굴착, 등반, 비행, 수영을 하는 동안에도 은밀 이동을 사용할 수 있으며, 이때 해당 속도의 절반으로 이동해야 합니다.)

이동이 끝날 때, GM은 당신의 은밀 이동 판정을 비밀리에 굴려서, 이동을 시작할 때 당신이 상대로부터 @link[conditions.hidden]이거나 @link[conditions.undetected] 상태였던 각 생명체의 감지 DC와 결과를 비교합니다. 이동하는 내내 그 생명체로부터 엄폐 또는 상위 엄폐를 받고 있다면, 엄폐로 인한 +2 환경 보너스(상위 엄폐라면 +4)를 은신 판정에 얻습니다. 이동 중이므로 엄폐 취하기로 인한 보너스 증가는 적용되지 않습니다. 이동이 끝날 때 그 생명체로부터 @link[conditions.concealed] 상태도 아니고 엄폐나 상위 엄폐도 받고 있지 않다면, 그 생명체를 상대로는 판정을 굴리지 못합니다. 그러한 생명체에게는 자동으로 발각됩니다.

성공 이동하는 동안 그 생명체에게 발각되지 않으며, 이동이 끝난 뒤에도 발각되지 않은 상태를 유지합니다.

숨기, 은밀 이동, 발놀림 외의 다른 행동을 하는 즉시 발각됩니다. 어떤 생명체에게 타격을 시도하면, 그 생명체는 해당 공격에 대해 @link[conditions.off-guard] 상태로 남고, 그 뒤 당신은 발각됩니다. 그 밖의 다른 행동을 하면, GM이 달리 판단하지 않는 한 행동하기 직전에 발각됩니다. GM은 특별히 눈에 띄지 않는 행동이라면 발각되지 않고 수행하도록 허용할 수 있으며, 이때 추가로 은신 판정을 요구할 수도 있습니다. 말을 하거나 의도적으로 큰 소리를 내면, 발각되지 않은 상태 대신 숨겨짐 상태가 됩니다.

어떤 생명체가 @link[actions.seek]을 사용하여 그 결과 당신이 그 생명체에게 숨겨짐 상태가 되었다면, 그 생명체에게 다시 발각되지 않은 상태가 되고 싶다면 은밀 이동을 해야 합니다.

실패 소리나 다른 흔적이 당신의 위치를 드러내지만, 여전히 모습은 보이지 않습니다. 이동하는 내내 그 생명체로부터 숨겨짐 상태이며, 그 상태를 유지합니다.

대실패 발각되고 말았습니다! 이동하는 내내 그 생명체에게 발각되며, 그 상태를 유지합니다. 당신이 @link[conditions.invisible] 상태이며 그 생명체로부터 숨겨짐 상태였다면, 발각되는 대신 이동하는 내내 숨겨짐 상태가 되고 그 상태를 유지합니다.

name: Spellsling

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding your bonded beast gun or another magic firearm

Effect You Cast a Spell that takes 1 or 2 actions to cast and requires a spell attack roll. The effects of the spell do not occur immediately but are imbued into the beast gun you're wielding. Make a Strike with that beast gun. Your spell flies with the ammunition, using your attack roll result to determine the effects of both the Strike and the spell. Combine the Strike and spell's damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses. This counts as two attacks for the purposes of determining your multiple attack penalty, but you don't apply the penalty until after you've completed resolving the attack and spell.

Special If you also have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3MiV0maH8imtnVwS]{Spell-Woven Shot} action you can load and activate a piece of magical ammunition as a free action before making a Spellsling attack once per 10 minutes.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding your bonded beast gun or another magic firearm

Effect You Cast a Spell that takes 1 or 2 actions to cast and requires a spell attack roll. The effects of the spell do not occur immediately but are imbued into the beast gun you're wielding. Make a Strike with that beast gun. Your spell flies with the ammunition, using your attack roll result to determine the effects of both the Strike and the spell. Combine the Strike and spell's damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses. This counts as two attacks for the purposes of determining your multiple attack penalty, but you don't apply the penalty until after you've completed resolving the attack and spell.

Special If you also have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3MiV0maH8imtnVwS]{Spell-Woven Shot} action you can load and activate a piece of magical ammunition as a free action before making a Spellsling attack once per 10 minutes.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신은 결속된 야수 총기 또는 다른 마법 화기를 들고 있습니다

효과 시전에 1 또는 2 행동이 들고 주문 명중 굴림이 필요한 주문을 시전합니다. 주문의 효과는 즉시 발생하지 않고 당신이 들고 있는 야수 총기에 깃듭니다. 그 야수 총기로 타격을 합니다. 주문이 탄약과 함께 날아가며, 당신의 명중 굴림 결과로 타격과 주문 양쪽의 효과를 결정합니다. 저항과 취약성을 따질 때에는 타격과 주문의 피해를 합산합니다. 이는 다중 공격 페널티를 결정할 때 두 번의 공격으로 취급하지만, 공격과 주문 해결을 완료하기 전까지는 페널티를 적용하지 않습니다.

특수 @link[actions.spell-woven-shot] 행동도 갖추고 있다면, 10분에 한 번 스펠샷 공격을 하기 전에 자유 행동으로 마법 탄약 한 발을 장전하고 활성화할 수 있습니다.

name: Foresight

description.value:
Trigger The target of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qsNeG9KZpODSACMq]{Foresight} defends against a hostile creature or other danger.

Effect If the hostile creature or danger forces the target to roll dice (a saving throw, for example), the target rolls twice and uses the higher result, and this spell gains the fortune trait. But if the hostile creature or danger is rolling against the target (an attack roll or skill check, for example), that hostile creature or danger rolls twice and uses the lower result, and this spell gains the misfortune trait.

_desc_en:
Trigger The target of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qsNeG9KZpODSACMq]{Foresight} defends against a hostile creature or other danger.

Effect If the hostile creature or danger forces the target to roll dice (a saving throw, for example), the target rolls twice and uses the higher result, and this spell gains the fortune trait. But if the hostile creature or danger is rolling against the target (an attack roll or skill check, for example), that hostile creature or danger rolls twice and uses the lower result, and this spell gains the misfortune trait.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 @link[spells.foresight]의 대상이 적대적인 크리처나 그 밖의 위험에 대해 방어합니다.

효과 적대적인 크리처나 위험이 대상으로 하여금 주사위를 굴리게 한다면(예를 들어 내성 판정), 대상은 두 번 굴려 더 높은 결과를 사용하며, 이 주문은 행운 특성을 얻습니다. 그러나 적대적인 크리처나 위험이 대상을 상대로 굴리는 경우라면(예를 들어 명중 굴림이나 기술 판정), 그 적대적인 크리처나 위험이 두 번 굴려 더 낮은 결과를 사용하며, 이 주문은 불운 특성을 얻습니다.

name: Stridulating Song

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Effect You circulate magic through your wings, causing them to vibrate at high speeds such that their scraping produces disruptive sounds. You focus the sound at one creature within 30 feet who must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher) or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure, as the vibrations disrupt its inner equilibrium. You can Sustain the effect for up to 1 minute; the creature can't recover from the sickened condition as long as you continue your song and it can hear you.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Effect You circulate magic through your wings, causing them to vibrate at high speeds such that their scraping produces disruptive sounds. You focus the sound at one creature within 30 feet who must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher) or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure, as the vibrations disrupt its inner equilibrium. You can Sustain the effect for up to 1 minute; the creature can't recover from the sickened condition as long as you continue your song and it can hear you.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

효과 당신은 날개에 마법을 순환시켜 날개를 고속으로 진동시키고, 그 마찰음이 방해가 되는 소리를 만들어내게 합니다. 그 소리를 30피트 이내의 한 크리처에게 집중시키면, 그 크리처는 당신의 클래스 DC 또는 주문 DC(둘 중 높은 쪽)를 상대로 인내 내성에 성공해야 하며, 실패하면 진동이 그 크리처의 내부 평형을 교란하여 @link[conditions.sickened]{1}(대실패 시 @link[conditions.sickened]{2})이 됩니다. 이 효과를 최대 1분까지 유지할 수 있으며, 당신이 노래를 계속하고 그 크리처가 당신의 소리를 들을 수 있는 한 그 크리처는 구역질 상태에서 회복할 수 없습니다.

name: Shadow Step

description.value:
Requirements The familiar is in dim light or darkness.

Effect The familiar teleports itself up to 30 feet. The destination must be in dim light or darkness and must be within your familiar's line of sight and line of effect.

This action has the trait matching your tradition of magic, or occult if you aren't a spellcaster.

_desc_en:
Requirements The familiar is in dim light or darkness.

Effect The familiar teleports itself up to 30 feet. The destination must be in dim light or darkness and must be within your familiar's line of sight and line of effect.

This action has the trait matching your tradition of magic, or occult if you aren't a spellcaster.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 사역마가 약한 빛이나 어둠 속에 있습니다.

효과 사역마가 자신을 최대 30피트까지 순간이동합니다. 목적지는 약한 빛이나 어둠 속이어야 하며, 사역마의 시야선과 효과선 안에 있어야 합니다.

이 행동은 당신의 마법 전통에 해당하는 특성을 가지며, 당신이 주문 시전자가 아니라면 신비 특성을 가집니다.

name: Spread Propaganda

description.value:
You spread propaganda about a faction (which may include an army, organization, or other particular group of people). This takes as long as it would normally take for you to Gather Information (typically 2 hours). At the end of this time, the GM rolls a secret Deception check to see how effective you were at spreading propaganda.

Critical Success Your propaganda spreads effectively, and for the next month, creatures that succeed on checks to Gather Information learn your propaganda over facts about the subject. It cannot be traced back to you. You also learn information as if you succeeded at a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check about the faction.

Success As critical success, but the propaganda persists for 1 week and can be traced back to you by a character who critically succeeds at the skill check to Gather Information.

Failure Your propaganda fails to take hold.

Critical Failure Your propaganda is stunningly ineffective, and you take a –4 circumstance penalty to Deception checks to spread propaganda about the same subject for 1 week. In addition, the subject and its enemies become aware that you attempted to spread propaganda.

_desc_en:
You spread propaganda about a faction (which may include an army, organization, or other particular group of people). This takes as long as it would normally take for you to Gather Information (typically 2 hours). At the end of this time, the GM rolls a secret Deception check to see how effective you were at spreading propaganda.

Critical Success Your propaganda spreads effectively, and for the next month, creatures that succeed on checks to Gather Information learn your propaganda over facts about the subject. It cannot be traced back to you. You also learn information as if you succeeded at a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check about the faction.

Success As critical success, but the propaganda persists for 1 week and can be traced back to you by a character who critically succeeds at the skill check to Gather Information.

Failure Your propaganda fails to take hold.

Critical Failure Your propaganda is stunningly ineffective, and you take a –4 circumstance penalty to Deception checks to spread propaganda about the same subject for 1 week. In addition, the subject and its enemies become aware that you attempted to spread propaganda.
_desc_ko:
당신은 어떤 파벌(군대, 조직, 또는 그 밖의 특정 집단을 포함할 수 있습니다)에 관한 선전을 퍼뜨립니다. 이는 정보 수집을 하는 데 통상적으로 걸리는 시간만큼(보통 2시간) 걸립니다. 이 시간이 끝날 때, GM은 당신이 선전을 얼마나 효과적으로 퍼뜨렸는지 확인하기 위해 비밀 기만 판정을 굴립니다.

대성공 당신의 선전이 효과적으로 퍼져, 다음 한 달 동안 정보 수집 판정에 성공하는 크리처는 그 대상에 관한 사실 대신 당신의 선전을 알게 됩니다. 그 출처는 당신으로 추적될 수 없습니다. 또한 당신은 그 파벌에 관한 @link[actions.recall-knowledge] 판정에 성공한 것처럼 정보를 얻습니다.

성공 대성공과 같으나, 선전은 1주일 동안 지속되며 정보 수집 기술 판정에 대성공한 인물에 의해 당신으로 추적될 수 있습니다.

실패 당신의 선전이 뿌리내리지 못합니다.

대실패 당신의 선전이 놀랄 만큼 효과가 없으며, 1주일 동안 같은 대상에 관한 선전을 퍼뜨리기 위한 기만 판정에 -4 환경 페널티를 받습니다. 게다가 그 대상과 그 대상의 적들은 당신이 선전을 퍼뜨리려 했다는 사실을 알게 됩니다.

name: Strike

description.value:
You attack with a weapon you're wielding or with an unarmed attack, targeting one creature within your reach (for a melee attack) or within range (for a ranged attack). Roll an attack roll using the attack modifier for the weapon or unarmed attack you're using, and compare the result to the target creature's AC to determine the effect.

Critical Success You make a damage roll according to the weapon or unarmed attack and deal double damage.

Success You make a damage roll according to the weapon or unarmed attack and deal damage.

_desc_en:
You attack with a weapon you're wielding or with an unarmed attack, targeting one creature within your reach (for a melee attack) or within range (for a ranged attack). Roll an attack roll using the attack modifier for the weapon or unarmed attack you're using, and compare the result to the target creature's AC to determine the effect.

Critical Success You make a damage roll according to the weapon or unarmed attack and deal double damage.

Success You make a damage roll according to the weapon or unarmed attack and deal damage.
_desc_ko:
당신은 들고 있는 무기 또는 비무장 공격으로, 사거리 내(근접 공격의 경우) 또는 사정거리 내(원거리 공격의 경우)의 한 크리처를 대상으로 공격합니다. 사용하는 무기나 비무장 공격의 공격 수정치를 사용해 명중 굴림을 하고, 그 결과를 대상 크리처의 AC와 비교하여 효과를 결정합니다.

대성공 무기나 비무장 공격에 따라 피해 굴림을 하고 두 배의 피해를 입힙니다.

성공 무기나 비무장 공격에 따라 피해 굴림을 하고 피해를 입힙니다.

name: Liberate Self

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}

Effect Attempt to Escape, rolling the check twice and taking the better result.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}

Effect Attempt to Escape, rolling the check twice and taking the better result.
_desc_ko:
사용 빈도 하루에 한 번

요구조건 당신은 @link[conditions.grabbed], @link[conditions.immobilized], 또는 @link[conditions.restrained] 상태입니다

효과 탈출을 시도하되, 판정을 두 번 굴려 더 나은 결과를 사용합니다.

name: Breath Weapon

description.value:
Your eidolon exhales a blast of destructive energy. Your eidolon deals 1d6 damage to all creatures in the area, with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC. The area and damage type of the Breath Weapon are chosen when the eidolon gains this ability. Your eidolon then can't use their Breath Weapon again for the next [[/r 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.

_desc_en:
Your eidolon exhales a blast of destructive energy. Your eidolon deals 1d6 damage to all creatures in the area, with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC. The area and damage type of the Breath Weapon are chosen when the eidolon gains this ability. Your eidolon then can't use their Breath Weapon again for the next [[/r 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.
_desc_ko:
당신의 에이돌론이 파괴적인 에너지를 내뿜습니다. 당신의 에이돌론은 해당 범위 내 모든 크리처에게 1d6 피해를 입히며, 대상은 당신의 주문 DC에 대해 기본 반사 내성을 굴립니다. 숨결 무기의 범위와 피해 유형은 에이돌론이 이 능력을 얻을 때 선택합니다. 그 후 당신의 에이돌론은 1d4 라운드 동안 숨결 무기를 다시 사용할 수 없습니다.

3레벨부터 이후 2레벨마다 피해가 1d6씩 증가합니다.

name: Threatening Approach

description.value: You Stride to be adjacent to a foe and [[/act demoralize]] that foe. If you succeed, the foe is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} instead of frightened 1.

_desc_en: You Stride to be adjacent to a foe and [[/act demoralize]] that foe. If you succeed, the foe is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} instead of frightened 1.
_desc_ko: 당신은 적과 인접하도록 이동한 뒤 그 적을 @link[actions.demoralize]합니다. 성공하면 그 적은 @link[conditions.frightened] 1이 아니라 겁먹음 2가 됩니다.

name: Tell Me More

description.value:
Target one creature that shares a language you speak

Requirements You're not in combat

Effect Just batting your eyes and giving someone a familiar nudge can get them talking, ready to spill the beans about everything and everyone around them. You roll twice on all rolls to influence the target and use the better result.

publication.title: Paizo Blog: Foolish Housekeeping and Other Articles

_desc_en:
Target one creature that shares a language you speak

Requirements You're not in combat

Effect Just batting your eyes and giving someone a familiar nudge can get them talking, ready to spill the beans about everything and everyone around them. You roll twice on all rolls to influence the target and use the better result.
_desc_ko:
대상 당신이 구사하는 언어를 공유하는 크리처 하나

요구조건 당신이 전투 중이 아님

효과 눈을 깜빡이며 친근하게 슬쩍 찔러주는 것만으로도 상대를 말하게 만들어, 주변의 모든 것과 모든 이에 관한 속사정을 술술 털어놓게 할 수 있습니다. 대상에게 영향을 미치는 모든 판정을 두 번 굴려 더 나은 결과를 사용합니다.

name: Command a Construct

description.value: You instruct your construct companion to act as you instruct it, and according to its programming. Your construct companion gains 2 actions during this turn. See the minion trait for details.

_desc_en: You instruct your construct companion to act as you instruct it, and according to its programming. Your construct companion gains 2 actions during this turn. See the minion trait for details.
_desc_ko: 당신은 당신의 구조물 동료에게 당신이 지시하는 대로, 그리고 그 프로그래밍에 따라 행동하도록 명령합니다. 당신의 구조물 동료는 이번 턴에 2개의 행동을 얻습니다. 자세한 내용은 부하(minion) 특성을 참조하십시오.

name: Impromptu Investment

description.value:
(one minute)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect You can remove investiture from an item you currently have invested, and this investiture does not count against your daily limit. You can invest a new item in this item's place.

_desc_en:
(one minute)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect You can remove investiture from an item you currently have invested, and this investiture does not count against your daily limit. You can invest a new item in this item's place.
_desc_ko:
(1분)

빈도 10분당 1회

효과 당신은 현재 장착(invest)하고 있는 아이템에서 장착을 해제할 수 있으며, 이 장착은 당신의 하루 한도에 포함되지 않습니다. 그 아이템 자리에 새로운 아이템을 장착할 수 있습니다.

name: Touch and Go

description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a combination weapon.

Your body's shadows mask your hands' steel. You can Step toward an enemy, you can Interact to change your weapon between melee or ranged modes, and you then Interact to reload.

_desc_en:
Requirements You're wielding a combination weapon.

Your body's shadows mask your hands' steel. You can Step toward an enemy, you can Interact to change your weapon between melee or ranged modes, and you then Interact to reload.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신이 조합 무기를 들고 있음.

당신 몸의 그림자가 손에 든 강철을 가립니다. 당신은 적을 향해 발놀림할 수 있고, 상호작용으로 무기를 근접 모드와 원거리 모드 사이에서 전환할 수 있으며, 그 다음 상호작용으로 재장전할 수 있습니다.

name: Swarming Assault

description.value:
Requirements Your eidolon is dispersed.

Your eidolon swarms over each creature occupying its space, biting, pecking, clawing, or making similar attacks with its component bodies. It deals @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level / 2))d6|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in the area, with a @Check[reflex|basic|options:area-effect] save against your spell DC. You choose each time your eidolon uses Swarming Assault whether it deals piercing or slashing damage. Your eidolon then can't use Swarming Assault again for the next [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Swarming Assault]]{1d4 rounds}.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.

_desc_en:
Requirements Your eidolon is dispersed.

Your eidolon swarms over each creature occupying its space, biting, pecking, clawing, or making similar attacks with its component bodies. It deals @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level / 2))d6|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in the area, with a @Check[reflex|basic|options:area-effect] save against your spell DC. You choose each time your eidolon uses Swarming Assault whether it deals piercing or slashing damage. Your eidolon then can't use Swarming Assault again for the next [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Swarming Assault]]{1d4 rounds}.

At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 당신의 에이돌론이 흩어진 상태임.

당신의 에이돌론이 자신의 공간을 차지하고 있는 각 크리처에게 무리로 뒤덮으며, 구성체들로 물어뜯고, 쪼고, 할퀴거나 그와 유사한 공격을 가합니다. 해당 범위 내 각 크리처에게 (에이돌론 레벨의 절반을 올림)d6 피해를 입히며, 대상은 당신의 주문 DC에 대해 기본 반사 내성을 굴립니다. 당신은 에이돌론이 무리 습격을 사용할 때마다 관통 피해를 입힐지 참격 피해를 입힐지 선택합니다. 그 후 당신의 에이돌론은 1d4 라운드 동안 무리 습격을 다시 사용할 수 없습니다.

3레벨부터 이후 2레벨마다 피해가 1d6씩 증가합니다.

name: Sever Four Dragonfly Wings

description.value: Make a Strike that deals slashing damage with your weapon ikon. If that Strike is successful, you can immediately make an additional Strike against a different target within your reach. You can continue making Strikes in this manner, each against a different target, until you have made a total of four Strikes or you miss with a Strike, whichever comes first. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but you do not increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.

_desc_en: Make a Strike that deals slashing damage with your weapon ikon. If that Strike is successful, you can immediately make an additional Strike against a different target within your reach. You can continue making Strikes in this manner, each against a different target, until you have made a total of four Strikes or you miss with a Strike, whichever comes first. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but you do not increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.
_desc_ko: 당신의 무기 이콘으로 참격 피해를 입히는 타격을 가합니다. 그 타격이 성공하면, 즉시 당신의 도달 거리 내에 있는 다른 대상을 향해 추가 타격을 가할 수 있습니다. 이런 식으로 각각 다른 대상을 향해 타격을 계속 이어갈 수 있으며, 총 네 번의 타격을 하거나 타격이 빗나갈 때까지 중 먼저 도달하는 쪽에서 멈춥니다. 각 공격은 당신의 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지만, 모든 공격을 마칠 때까지는 페널티가 증가하지 않습니다.

name: Hide

description.value:
You huddle behind cover or greater cover or deeper into concealment to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, rather than @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed}. The GM rolls your [[/act hide]]{Stealth} check in secret and compares the result to the Perception DC of each creature you're observed by but that you have cover or greater cover against or are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from. You get a +2 circumstance bonus to your check if you have standard cover (or +4 from greater cover).

Success If the creature could see you, you're now @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from it instead of observed. If you were hidden from or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by the creature, you retain that condition.

If you successfully become hidden to a creature but then cease to have cover or greater cover against it or be concealed from it, you become observed again. You cease being hidden if you do anything except Hide, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Step}. If you attempt to Strike a creature, the creature remains off-guard against that attack, and you then become observed. If you do anything else, you become observed just before you act unless the GM determines otherwise. The GM might allow you to perform a particularly unobtrusive action without being noticed, possibly requiring another Stealth check.

If a creature uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} to make you observed by it, you must successfully Hide to become hidden from it again.

_desc_en:
You huddle behind cover or greater cover or deeper into concealment to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, rather than @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed}. The GM rolls your [[/act hide]]{Stealth} check in secret and compares the result to the Perception DC of each creature you're observed by but that you have cover or greater cover against or are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from. You get a +2 circumstance bonus to your check if you have standard cover (or +4 from greater cover).

Success If the creature could see you, you're now @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} from it instead of observed. If you were hidden from or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by the creature, you retain that condition.

If you successfully become hidden to a creature but then cease to have cover or greater cover against it or be concealed from it, you become observed again. You cease being hidden if you do anything except Hide, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Step}. If you attempt to Strike a creature, the creature remains off-guard against that attack, and you then become observed. If you do anything else, you become observed just before you act unless the GM determines otherwise. The GM might allow you to perform a particularly unobtrusive action without being noticed, possibly requiring another Stealth check.

If a creature uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} to make you observed by it, you must successfully Hide to become hidden from it again.
_desc_ko:
엄폐물이나 우수한 엄폐물 뒤에 웅크리거나 은폐 속으로 더 깊이 몸을 숨겨 @link[conditions.observed] 대신 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태가 됩니다. GM은 당신의 은신 판정을 비밀리에 굴려, 그 결과를 당신이 발각된 상태이지만 당신이 엄폐물이나 우수한 엄폐물을 확보하고 있거나 당신에게 @link[conditions.concealed]된 각 크리처의 지각 DC와 비교합니다. 표준 엄폐물을 확보하고 있으면 판정에 +2 상황 보너스를 받습니다(우수한 엄폐물이면 +4).

성공 그 크리처가 당신을 볼 수 있었다면, 당신은 이제 그 크리처에게 발각됨 대신 @link[conditions.hidden] 상태가 됩니다. 당신이 그 크리처에게 숨겨짐이나 @link[conditions.undetected] 상태였다면, 그 상태를 유지합니다.

성공적으로 어떤 크리처에게 숨겨짐 상태가 되었더라도, 그 후 그 크리처에 대해 엄폐물이나 우수한 엄폐물을 확보하지 못하게 되거나 은폐되지 않게 되면 다시 발각됩니다. 숨기, @link[actions.sneak], @link[actions.step] 외의 다른 행동을 하면 숨겨짐 상태가 끝납니다. 크리처를 타격하려 시도하면, 그 크리처는 그 공격에 대해 무방비 상태를 유지하고, 이후 당신은 발각됩니다. 그 밖의 어떤 행동을 하면, GM이 달리 판정하지 않는 한 당신은 행동하기 직전에 발각됩니다. GM은 당신이 특별히 눈에 띄지 않는 행동을 들키지 않고 수행하도록 허용할 수 있으며, 이때 또 다른 은신 판정을 요구할 수도 있습니다.

어떤 크리처가 @link[actions.seek]을 사용해 당신을 발각하면, 그 크리처에게 다시 숨겨짐 상태가 되려면 성공적으로 숨기를 해야 합니다.

name: Indomitable Act

description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You are about to attempt a check

Requirements You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}

Effect You lean into your fear, using it to embolden you. You can roll the triggering check twice and take the higher result. This is a fortune effect.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You are about to attempt a check

Requirements You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}

Effect You lean into your fear, using it to embolden you. You can roll the triggering check twice and take the higher result. This is a fortune effect.
_desc_ko:
빈도 하루 1회

발동 조건 판정을 시도하려는 참입니다

요구 사항 당신이 @link[conditions.frightened] 상태입니다

효과 당신은 두려움에 기대어 그것을 담대함의 원천으로 삼습니다. 발동 조건이 된 판정을 두 번 굴려 더 높은 결과를 취할 수 있습니다. 이것은 행운 효과입니다.

name: Resist Magic

description.value:
Trigger You attempt a saving throw against a harmful magical effect but haven't rolled yet.

Your innate magic protects you. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw. Additionally, if the triggering effect is arcane, if you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.

_desc_en:
Trigger You attempt a saving throw against a harmful magical effect but haven't rolled yet.

Your innate magic protects you. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw. Additionally, if the triggering effect is arcane, if you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 유해한 마법 효과에 대한 내성을 시도하지만 아직 굴리지 않았습니다.

당신의 타고난 마법이 당신을 보호합니다. 발동 조건이 된 내성에 +1 상황 보너스를 받습니다. 또한, 발동 조건이 된 효과가 비전(arcane) 효과라면, 성공을 굴린 경우 대신 대성공으로 처리됩니다.

name: Plummeting Roll

description.value:
Trigger You fall at least 10 feet and take no damage from the fall

Effect You tuck and roll with the motion. You land on your feet and Stride up to half your Speed

_desc_en:
Trigger You fall at least 10 feet and take no damage from the fall

Effect You tuck and roll with the motion. You land on your feet and Stride up to half your Speed
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 최소 10피트 낙하하면서 낙하로 인한 피해를 전혀 받지 않습니다

효과 당신은 그 움직임에 맞춰 몸을 웅크려 구릅니다. 두 발로 착지하며 이동 속도의 절반까지 이동합니다

name: Shatter Glass

description.value:
Trigger An adjacent creature Strikes you with a melee weapon or unarmed attack and deals damage

Requirements Your innate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2BV2yYPfVJ5zirZt]{Mountain Resilience} from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.VF5XFpzBlqUFd8Mw]{Glass Skin} is active

Effect You shatter some of the glass on your skin to damage your attacker. The attacker takes @Damage[3d10[slashing]] damage and the duration of the stoneskin decreases by 1 minute. At 14th level, the damage increases to @Damage[4d10[slashing]] damage, and at 18th level, the damage increases to @Damage[5d10[slashing]] damage.

_desc_en:
Trigger An adjacent creature Strikes you with a melee weapon or unarmed attack and deals damage

Requirements Your innate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2BV2yYPfVJ5zirZt]{Mountain Resilience} from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.VF5XFpzBlqUFd8Mw]{Glass Skin} is active

Effect You shatter some of the glass on your skin to damage your attacker. The attacker takes @Damage[3d10[slashing]] damage and the duration of the stoneskin decreases by 1 minute. At 14th level, the damage increases to @Damage[4d10[slashing]] damage, and at 18th level, the damage increases to @Damage[5d10[slashing]] damage.
_desc_ko:
발동 조건 인접한 크리처가 근접 무기나 비무장 공격으로 당신을 타격하여 피해를 입힙니다

요구 사항 @link[feats.glass-skin]로 얻은 당신의 타고난 @link[spells.mountain-resilience]이 활성화되어 있습니다

효과 당신은 피부에 있는 유리 일부를 깨뜨려 공격자에게 피해를 입힙니다. 공격자는 3d10 참격 피해를 받고, 석화 피부(stoneskin)의 지속 시간이 1분 감소합니다. 14레벨에서 피해가 4d10 참격 피해로 증가하고, 18레벨에서 피해가 5d10 참격 피해로 증가합니다.

name: Restore the Mind

description.value:
Your unleashed psyche gives you closer connections to the emotions of your allies, letting you project reassurance and strength that replenishes their mind and body. Choose one of the two benefits to grant one ally within 30 feet that you can see. That ally is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

  • The ally gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws against mental effects until your psyche ends.
  • The ally regains Hit Points equal to @Damage[(2+2*@actor.level)[healing]]{2 + double your level}.

_desc_en:
Your unleashed psyche gives you closer connections to the emotions of your allies, letting you project reassurance and strength that replenishes their mind and body. Choose one of the two benefits to grant one ally within 30 feet that you can see. That ally is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

  • The ally gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws against mental effects until your psyche ends.
  • The ally regains Hit Points equal to @Damage[(2+2*@actor.level)[healing]]{2 + double your level}.
_desc_ko:
해방된 당신의 정신은 동료들의 감정과 더 가까운 연결을 부여하여, 그들의 정신과 육체를 회복시키는 안심과 힘을 투사하게 합니다. 두 가지 이점 중 하나를 골라, 당신이 볼 수 있는 30피트 이내의 동료 하나에게 부여합니다. 그 동료는 이후 10분간 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

  • 그 동료는 당신의 정신 해방이 끝날 때까지 정신 효과에 대한 내성에 +1 상태 보너스를 얻습니다.
  • 그 동료는 2 + 당신의 레벨의 두 배에 해당하는 HP를 회복합니다.

name: Blazing Conflagration

description.value:
Requirements You're transformed into phoenix form by the monstrosity form spell granted by this feat

Effect You dismiss phoenix form while a fiery corona erupts from you as searing light. Each creature in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] takes @Damage[max(16,(2*(floor(@actor.level/2))))d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:spell|basic|options:area-effect] save against your spell DC; creatures that critically fail are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round. You gain 8d6 temporary Hit Points. At 18th level and again at 20th level, the burst deals an additional 2d6 fire damage, and you gain an additional 1d6 temporary Hit Points.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide
