필요조건 울그렘-아사안의 간격 내에 있는 크리처가 넘어짐 상태이며, 울그렘-아사안이 현재 다른 크리처를 붙잡고 있지 않습니다

효과 울그렘-아사안이 그 크리처에게 턱 타격을 시도합니다. 성공하면 울그렘-아사안은 즉시 그 크리처를 @link[conditions.grabbed]하고, 그 크리처는 추가로 2d10 타격 피해를 받습니다.

name: (Special Forces) Composite Bows

description.value: The special forces unit has trained snipers in its ranks. Increase the range of its Short Salvo ability to 120 feet and its damage to @Damage[5d10[piercing]] damage. Troops with these bows can't be war mages, can't have shields, and can't be mounted.

_desc_en: The special forces unit has trained snipers in its ranks. Increase the range of its Short Salvo ability to 120 feet and its damage to @Damage[5d10[piercing]] damage. Troops with these bows can't be war mages, can't have shields, and can't be mounted.
_desc_ko: 특수부대 부대는 대열 안에 훈련된 저격수를 두고 있습니다. 짧은 일제사격(Short Salvo) 능력의 사거리를 120피트로, 피해를 5d10 관통 피해로 증가시킵니다. 이 활을 사용하는 부대는 전쟁 마법사가 될 수 없고, 방패를 들 수 없으며, 탈것에 탈 수 없습니다.

name: (Special Forces) Dirty Fighting

description.value: The special forces unit tries to disrupt the enemy's ability to fight back by disarming their weapons, kicking dust in their eyes, and so on. Attempt an @Check[athletics|against:reflex] check against the Reflex DC of every enemy within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5]. On a success, that enemy takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls for 1 round, or if affecting a troop, a –2 circumstance penalty to that troop's DCs for damaging effects for 1 round. On a critical success, this penalty lasts for 2 rounds.

_desc_en: The special forces unit tries to disrupt the enemy's ability to fight back by disarming their weapons, kicking dust in their eyes, and so on. Attempt an @Check[athletics|against:reflex] check against the Reflex DC of every enemy within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5]. On a success, that enemy takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls for 1 round, or if affecting a troop, a –2 circumstance penalty to that troop's DCs for damaging effects for 1 round. On a critical success, this penalty lasts for 2 rounds.
_desc_ko: 특수부대 부대는 무기를 떨어뜨리게 하고, 눈에 흙을 차넣는 등의 방법으로 적이 반격하는 능력을 방해하려 합니다. 5피트 발산 내의 모든 적을 상대로 그 적의 반사 DC에 맞서는 운동 판정을 시도합니다. 성공하면 그 적은 1라운드 동안 명중 굴림에 -2 상황 페널티를 받으며, 부대에 영향을 줄 경우 그 부대는 1라운드 동안 피해 효과의 DC에 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다. 대성공하면 이 페널티는 2라운드 동안 지속됩니다.

name: (Skeleton) Bone Missile

description.value:
The skeleton yanks a rib from its ribcage to use as an arrow or javelin. The skeleton loses HP equal to its level (minimum 1), then makes a ranged Strike.

This uses the attack bonus of whichever of the skeleton's other Strikes has the highest attack bonus and deals piercing damage equal to that Strike's damage plus the skeleton's level (minimum 1).

_desc_en:
The skeleton yanks a rib from its ribcage to use as an arrow or javelin. The skeleton loses HP equal to its level (minimum 1), then makes a ranged Strike.

This uses the attack bonus of whichever of the skeleton's other Strikes has the highest attack bonus and deals piercing damage equal to that Strike's damage plus the skeleton's level (minimum 1).
_desc_ko:
스켈레톤이 자신의 갈비뼈에서 갈빗대 하나를 뽑아 화살이나 투창으로 사용합니다. 스켈레톤은 자신의 레벨과 같은 만큼의 HP를 잃은 뒤(최소 1), 원거리 타격을 실시합니다.

이 타격은 스켈레톤의 다른 타격 중 명중 보너스가 가장 높은 것의 명중 보너스를 사용하며, 그 타격의 피해에 스켈레톤의 레벨을 더한 만큼(최소 1)의 관통 피해를 입힙니다.

name: (Kuworsys) Smash and Grab

description.value: Kuworsys Strides up to twice its Speed. At the end of its movement, it can make a melee limb Strike. On a successful Strike, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} until the end of Kuworsys's next turn

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

_desc_en: Kuworsys Strides up to twice its Speed. At the end of its movement, it can make a melee limb Strike. On a successful Strike, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} until the end of Kuworsys's next turn
_desc_ko: 쿠워시스가 자신의 이동력의 최대 2배까지 이동합니다. 이동이 끝날 때, 근접 사지 타격을 실시할 수 있습니다. 타격이 성공하면 그 크리처는 쿠워시스의 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 @link[conditions.grabbed] 상태가 됩니다

name: (Cinder Dragon) Inflame Emotions

description.value:
The dragon sends out a wave of heat that inflames emotions with 90 feet. Creatures within it must attempt a @Check[will] save with a DC equal to the dragon's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.etMnv73EIdEZrYYu]{Frightful Presence} DC. Regardless of the results, they are then immune to Inflame Emotions for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature can spend a reaction to make a melee Strike against a target of its choice.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature immediately makes a melee Strike against a target of the dragon's choice. The creature cannot use reactions until the start of its next turn.

_desc_en:
The dragon sends out a wave of heat that inflames emotions with 90 feet. Creatures within it must attempt a @Check[will] save with a DC equal to the dragon's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.etMnv73EIdEZrYYu]{Frightful Presence} DC. Regardless of the results, they are then immune to Inflame Emotions for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature can spend a reaction to make a melee Strike against a target of its choice.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature immediately makes a melee Strike against a target of the dragon's choice. The creature cannot use reactions until the start of its next turn.
_desc_ko:
용이 열기의 파동을 내보내 90피트 내의 감정을 자극합니다. 그 범위 내의 크리처는 용의 @link[actions.frightful-presence] DC와 같은 DC로 의지 내성을 시도해야 합니다. 결과와 관계없이, 그 크리처들은 이후 1분 동안 감정 자극에 면역이 됩니다.

대성공 크리처는 반응행동을 소비하여 자신이 선택한 대상에게 근접 타격을 실시할 수 있습니다.

성공 크리처는 영향을 받지 않습니다.

실패 크리처는 즉시 용이 선택한 대상에게 근접 타격을 실시합니다. 그 크리처는 자신의 다음 턴이 시작될 때까지 반응행동을 사용할 수 없습니다.

name: (Cryptid, Mutant) Unusual Bane

description.value: The mutant cryptid gains an unusual weakness to a specific bane—such as aversion to saffron or to the sound of children's laughter. The first time each round the creature comes within 15 feet of its bane or interacts with its bane (such as stepping over a line of saffron or hearing children laugh) it takes an amount of mental damage equal to its level and must attempt a Will save with a hard DC for its level. On a failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} on a critical failure).

_desc_en: The mutant cryptid gains an unusual weakness to a specific bane—such as aversion to saffron or to the sound of children's laughter. The first time each round the creature comes within 15 feet of its bane or interacts with its bane (such as stepping over a line of saffron or hearing children laugh) it takes an amount of mental damage equal to its level and must attempt a Will save with a hard DC for its level. On a failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} on a critical failure).
_desc_ko: 이 돌연변이 크립티드는 특정한 약점—예컨대 사프란이나 아이들의 웃음소리에 대한 거부반응—에 대해 기이한 약점을 가집니다. 매 라운드 처음으로 이 크리처가 자신의 약점 대상 15피트 이내로 접근하거나 그 약점과 상호작용할 때(사프란 선을 넘거나 아이들이 웃는 소리를 듣는 등), 자신의 레벨과 같은 양의 정신 피해를 입고 자신의 레벨에 대한 어려움 DC로 의지 내성을 시도해야 합니다. 실패하면 @link[conditions.stunned]{1}에 걸리며(대실패 시 @link[conditions.stunned]{3}).

name: (Nymph Queen) Focus Beauty

description.value:
The nymph queen focuses her beauty upon a target, who must attempt a save against her nymph's beauty aura (@Check[will|dc:0] save). If the creature fails and was already affected by the aura, it takes a greater effect described in the nymph queen's entry.

A nymph queen can Focus Beauty on a given creature only once per turn.

_desc_en:
The nymph queen focuses her beauty upon a target, who must attempt a save against her nymph's beauty aura (@Check[will|dc:0] save). If the creature fails and was already affected by the aura, it takes a greater effect described in the nymph queen's entry.

A nymph queen can Focus Beauty on a given creature only once per turn.
_desc_ko:
님프 여왕이 자신의 아름다움을 대상에게 집중하며, 대상은 님프 여왕의 님프 아름다움 오라에 대해 내성을 시도해야 합니다(의지 내성 DC 0). 크리처가 실패하고 이미 그 오라의 영향을 받고 있었다면, 님프 여왕의 항목에 설명된 더 강력한 효과를 받습니다.

님프 여왕은 주어진 크리처에게 턴당 한 번만 아름다움 집중을 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: (Ghast) Stench

description.value:
10 feet. A creature entering the aura or starting its turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (plus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as long as it's sickened on a critical failure).

While within the aura, the creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to saves against disease and to recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.wX9L6fbqVMLP05hn]{Effect: Stench}

_desc_en:
10 feet. A creature entering the aura or starting its turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (plus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as long as it's sickened on a critical failure).

While within the aura, the creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to saves against disease and to recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.wX9L6fbqVMLP05hn]{Effect: Stench}
_desc_ko: 10피트. 이 오라에 진입하거나 오라 안에서 자신의 턴을 시작하는 크리처는 인내 내성에 성공해야 하며, 실패하면 @link[conditions.sickened]{1}에 걸립니다(대실패 시 구역질이 지속되는 한 @link[conditions.slowed]{1}도 추가). 오라 안에 있는 동안 크리처는 질병에 대한 내성과 구역질 상태에서 회복하기 위한 판정에 -2 상황 페널티를 받습니다. 내성에 성공한 크리처는 1분간 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

name: (Mana Wastes Mutant) Eldritch Attraction

description.value: A creature who casts a spell within 30 feet of the mutant must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:] save or spend its next action to Stride toward the mutant. It can't Delay or take any reactions until it has obeyed the compulsion.

_desc_en: A creature who casts a spell within 30 feet of the mutant must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:] save or spend its next action to Stride toward the mutant. It can't Delay or take any reactions until it has obeyed the compulsion.
_desc_ko: 이 돌연변이의 30피트 이내에서 주문을 시전하는 크리처는 의지 내성에 성공해야 하며, 실패하면 다음 행동을 소모해 돌연변이를 향해 이동해야 합니다. 그 크리처는 이 강제에 따를 때까지 지연하거나 어떤 반응행동도 취할 수 없습니다.

name: (Path Maiden) Apostate's Shroud

description.value: All path maidens have an apostate's shroud unarmed attack that deals mental damage. This attack, which manifests as a whipping lash from the path maiden's sleeves or hem, has the agile, finesse, and magical traits. A creature damaged by this attack must succeed at a Fortitude save against the path maiden's spell DC. On a failure, the creature becomes cursed for 1 hour; if the creature dies while cursed, it immediately rises from death as a ghost. If the creature is a lower level than the path maiden that cursed it, it treats that path maiden as an ally and loyally obeys her; otherwise, it manifests as a free-willed ghost. In either case, it becomes site bound to the site of their death.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en: All path maidens have an apostate's shroud unarmed attack that deals mental damage. This attack, which manifests as a whipping lash from the path maiden's sleeves or hem, has the agile, finesse, and magical traits. A creature damaged by this attack must succeed at a Fortitude save against the path maiden's spell DC. On a failure, the creature becomes cursed for 1 hour; if the creature dies while cursed, it immediately rises from death as a ghost. If the creature is a lower level than the path maiden that cursed it, it treats that path maiden as an ally and loyally obeys her; otherwise, it manifests as a free-willed ghost. In either case, it becomes site bound to the site of their death.
_desc_ko: 모든 길의 처녀는 정신 피해를 입히는 배교자의 장막 비무장 공격을 가집니다. 길의 처녀의 소맷자락이나 옷단에서 채찍처럼 뻗어 나오는 형태로 발현되는 이 공격은 기민, 정교, 마법 특성을 가집니다. 이 공격에 피해를 입은 크리처는 길의 처녀의 주문 DC에 대해 인내 내성에 성공해야 합니다. 실패하면 그 크리처는 1시간 동안 저주받으며, 저주받은 상태에서 죽으면 즉시 죽음에서 유령으로 되살아납니다. 그 크리처가 저주를 건 길의 처녀보다 낮은 레벨이라면, 그 길의 처녀를 아군으로 대하며 충실히 복종합니다. 그렇지 않으면 자유 의지를 지닌 유령으로 발현됩니다. 어느 경우든 그 크리처는 자신이 죽은 장소에 결속됩니다.

name: (Horned Dragon) Apex Dominance

description.value: When the dragon casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} on a creature with the animal trait, the result of the target's saving throw is one degree of success worse. An animal the dragon controls with this spell can speak Draconic and gains a +2 status bonus to any Intelligence-, Wisdom-, and Charisma-based skill checks it attempts while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}.

_desc_en: When the dragon casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} on a creature with the animal trait, the result of the target's saving throw is one degree of success worse. An animal the dragon controls with this spell can speak Draconic and gains a +2 status bonus to any Intelligence-, Wisdom-, and Charisma-based skill checks it attempts while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}.
_desc_ko: 이 용이 동물 특성을 가진 크리처에게 @link[spells.dominate]를 시전하면, 대상의 내성 판정 결과가 한 단계 나쁜 성공 등급으로 처리됩니다. 이 용이 이 주문으로 조종하는 동물은 용언을 말할 수 있으며, @link[conditions.controlled] 상태인 동안 시도하는 지능·지혜·매력 기반 기술 판정에 +2 상태 보너스를 받습니다.

name: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Siccatite)

description.value:
Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.

Siccatite After the stargut hydra takes fire damage, it becomes superheated, gaining immunity to fire and weakness 10 to cold. While superheated, cold damage can be used to cauterize a stump. After the stargut hydra takes cold damage, it becomes chilled, gaining immunity to cold and weakness 10 to fire.

_desc_en:
Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.

Siccatite After the stargut hydra takes fire damage, it becomes superheated, gaining immunity to fire and weakness 10 to cold. While superheated, cold damage can be used to cauterize a stump. After the stargut hydra takes cold damage, it becomes chilled, gaining immunity to cold and weakness 10 to fire.
_desc_ko:
각 별창자 히드라는 특정 천상금속을 섭취하고 그 특성을 체내화한 결과로 최소 하나의 변형을 지닙니다.

시카타이트 별창자 히드라가 화염 피해를 입은 뒤에는 과열 상태가 되어 화염에 대한 면역과 냉기에 대한 약점 10을 얻습니다. 과열 상태인 동안에는 냉기 피해로 잘린 목을 지질 수 있습니다. 별창자 히드라가 냉기 피해를 입은 뒤에는 냉각 상태가 되어 냉기에 대한 면역과 화염에 대한 약점 10을 얻습니다.

name: (Despair Dragon) Lights Out

description.value: The despair dragon belches an impenetrable darkness that encompasses a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of a spell rank equal to half the dragon's level or lower. Light can't pass through, so all creatures in the area except for the dragon can't see outside.

_desc_en: The despair dragon belches an impenetrable darkness that encompasses a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of a spell rank equal to half the dragon's level or lower. Light can't pass through, so all creatures in the area except for the dragon can't see outside.
_desc_ko: 절망 용이 30피트 발산 범위를 뒤덮는 뚫을 수 없는 어둠을 토해냅니다. 빛은 이 영역에 들어오지 못하며, 횃불이나 등불 같은 비마법 광원은 영역 안에 있는 동안 그 빛 반경이 어둠 너머까지 미치더라도 어떤 빛도 발하지 못합니다. 이것은 또한 용의 레벨 절반 이하와 같은 주문 등급의 마법 빛도 억제합니다. 빛이 통과할 수 없으므로, 용을 제외한 영역 안의 모든 크리처는 바깥을 볼 수 없습니다.

name: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Nosferatu Vulnerabilities

description.value:
• Revulsion A nosferatu can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of brandished garlic or a brandished religious symbol of a deity with a holy sanctification option. To brandish garlic or a religious symbol, a creature must Interact to do so for 1 round (similar to Raising a Shield). If the nosferatu involuntarily comes within 10 feet of an object of their revulsion, they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition, running from the object of their revulsion until they end an action beyond 10 feet. After 1 round of being exposed to the subject of their revulsion, a nosferatu can attempt a @Check[will|dc:25|traits:concentrate] save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, they overcome their revulsions for [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} (or 1 hour on a critical success).
  • Stake A magical wooden stake (such as one affected by a weapon potency rune, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TFitdEOpQC4SzKQQ]{Runic Weapon}, or similar magic) driven through the nosferatu's heart drops the nosferatu to 0 HP and prevents them from healing above 0 HP, even in their coffin. Staking a nosferatu requires 3 actions and works only if the nosferatu is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. If the stake is removed, the nosferatu can heal above 0 HP again, and if they're in their coffin, the 1-hour rest period begins once the stake is removed. If the nosferatu's head is severed and anointed with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.z9T4c1hXwOotsMCp]{Holy Water} while the stake is in place, the nosferatu is destroyed.

  • Sunlight If exposed to direct sunlight, a nosferatu immediately becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. The slowed value increases by 1 each time the nosferatu ends their turn in sunlight, and the condition ends when they're no longer in sunlight. If the nosferatu loses all their actions in this way, they're destroyed.

_desc_en:
• Revulsion A nosferatu can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of brandished garlic or a brandished religious symbol of a deity with a holy sanctification option. To brandish garlic or a religious symbol, a creature must Interact to do so for 1 round (similar to Raising a Shield). If the nosferatu involuntarily comes within 10 feet of an object of their revulsion, they gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition, running from the object of their revulsion until they end an action beyond 10 feet. After 1 round of being exposed to the subject of their revulsion, a nosferatu can attempt a @Check[will|dc:25|traits:concentrate] save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, they overcome their revulsions for [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} (or 1 hour on a critical success).
  • Stake A magical wooden stake (such as one affected by a weapon potency rune, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TFitdEOpQC4SzKQQ]{Runic Weapon}, or similar magic) driven through the nosferatu's heart drops the nosferatu to 0 HP and prevents them from healing above 0 HP, even in their coffin. Staking a nosferatu requires 3 actions and works only if the nosferatu is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. If the stake is removed, the nosferatu can heal above 0 HP again, and if they're in their coffin, the 1-hour rest period begins once the stake is removed. If the nosferatu's head is severed and anointed with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.z9T4c1hXwOotsMCp]{Holy Water} while the stake is in place, the nosferatu is destroyed.

  • Sunlight If exposed to direct sunlight, a nosferatu immediately becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. The slowed value increases by 1 each time the nosferatu ends their turn in sunlight, and the condition ends when they're no longer in sunlight. If the nosferatu loses all their actions in this way, they're destroyed.
_desc_ko:
• 혐오 노스페라투는 치켜든 마늘이나 신성 신성화 옵션을 지닌 신격의 치켜든 종교 상징으로부터 10피트 이내에 자발적으로 다가갈 수 없습니다. 마늘이나 종교 상징을 치켜들려면 크리처는 1라운드 동안 상호작용해야 합니다(방패 들기와 유사합니다). 노스페라투가 자신의 혐오 대상으로부터 10피트 이내에 비자발적으로 들어가면 @link[conditions.fleeing] 상태이상을 얻어, 혐오 대상으로부터 10피트 밖에서 행동을 마칠 때까지 도망칩니다. 혐오 대상에 1라운드 동안 노출된 후, 노스페라투는 단일 행동으로 정신집중 특성을 지닌 의지 내성 DC 25 판정(정신집중 특성)을 시도할 수 있습니다. 성공하면 1d6 라운드 동안(대성공 시 1시간 동안) 혐오를 극복합니다.
  • 말뚝 노스페라투의 심장을 관통해 박힌 마법 나무 말뚝(무기 강화 룬, @link[spells.runic-weapon], 또는 이와 유사한 마법의 영향을 받은 것 등)은 노스페라투를 0 HP로 떨어뜨리며, 심지어 관 속에서도 0 HP 이상으로 치유되지 못하게 막습니다. 노스페라투에게 말뚝을 박는 데에는 3행동이 필요하며, 노스페라투가 @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태일 때만 효과가 있습니다. 말뚝이 제거되면 노스페라투는 다시 0 HP 이상으로 치유될 수 있으며, 관 속에 있다면 말뚝이 제거되는 즉시 1시간 휴식 기간이 시작됩니다. 말뚝이 박혀 있는 동안 노스페라투의 머리가 잘리고 @link[equipment.holy-water]로 바르면 노스페라투는 파괴됩니다.

  • 햇빛 직사광선에 노출되면 노스페라투는 즉시 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 됩니다. 노스페라투가 햇빛 속에서 자신의 턴을 마칠 때마다 감속 수치가 1씩 증가하며, 더 이상 햇빛 속에 있지 않게 되면 상태이상이 종료됩니다. 이런 식으로 노스페라투가 모든 행동을 잃으면 파괴됩니다.

name: (Blight) Oversee Domain

description.value: The blight projects its senses to any point in its cursed domain, gaining a precise sense of its surroundings with a 500-foot radius until the end of its next turn. A blight can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} through this sensory link. A blight can Sustain this ability, but cannot use it to extend its senses beyond the edges of its domain.

publication.title: Pathfinder #211: The Secret of Deathstalk Tower

_desc_en: The blight projects its senses to any point in its cursed domain, gaining a precise sense of its surroundings with a 500-foot radius until the end of its next turn. A blight can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} through this sensory link. A blight can Sustain this ability, but cannot use it to extend its senses beyond the edges of its domain.
_desc_ko: 마름병은 자신의 저주받은 영역 내의 어느 지점으로든 감각을 투사하여, 다음 턴이 끝날 때까지 500피트 반경으로 주변에 대한 정밀 감각을 얻습니다. 마름병은 이 감각 연결을 통해 @link[spells.dominate]를 시전할 수 있습니다. 마름병은 이 능력을 유지할 수 있으나, 이를 이용해 감각을 영역의 경계 너머로 확장할 수는 없습니다.

name: (Special Forces) Punitive Attack

description.value:
Trigger An enemy within 5 feet of the special forces unit uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using

Effect The special forces troops swing their weapons. The triggering enemy takes @Damage[(5d6+10)[slashing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:34|basic] save). If the creature critically fails its saving throw and the trigger was a manipulate action, the troop disrupts that action.

_desc_en:
Trigger An enemy within 5 feet of the special forces unit uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using

Effect The special forces troops swing their weapons. The triggering enemy takes @Damage[(5d6+10)[slashing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:34|basic] save). If the creature critically fails its saving throw and the trigger was a manipulate action, the troop disrupts that action.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 특수 부대로부터 5피트 이내의 적이 조작 행동이나 이동 행동을 사용하거나, 원거리 공격을 하거나, 사용 중인 이동 행동 도중에 한 칸을 벗어남

효과 특수 부대 병사들이 무기를 휘두릅니다. 발동조건을 유발한 적은 5d6+10 참격 피해를 입습니다(기본 반사 내성 DC 34). 크리처가 내성을 대실패하고 발동조건이 조작 행동이었다면, 병사들은 그 행동을 방해합니다.

name: (Siabrae) Stone Antlers

description.value: The siabrae grows a pair of stony antlers or horns from its head, which give it an antler attack that deals @Damage[(1d6+2)[bludgeoning]] damage for every 3 levels and inflicts stony shards. If the siabrae wishes, they can keep these antlers while polymorphed, using the normal statistics of the stone antler attack.

_desc_en: The siabrae grows a pair of stony antlers or horns from its head, which give it an antler attack that deals @Damage[(1d6+2)[bludgeoning]] damage for every 3 levels and inflicts stony shards. If the siabrae wishes, they can keep these antlers while polymorphed, using the normal statistics of the stone antler attack.
_desc_ko: 시아브레는 머리에서 돌로 된 뿔 한 쌍을 자라나게 하며, 이는 3레벨마다 1d6+2 타격 피해를 입히고 돌 파편을 박아 넣는 뿔 공격을 부여합니다. 시아브레가 원한다면 변신한 상태에서도 이 뿔을 유지하여 돌 뿔 공격의 일반 수치를 사용할 수 있습니다.

name: (Whisper Dragon) Draft Contract

description.value: The dragon produces a contract for a single living mortal. This contract can grant a single boon or ability, the extent of which is dependent on the power of the dragon, in exchange for one piece of knowledge the mortal possesses. The mortal must willingly sign their true name to the contract, as well as the knowledge they wish to surrender. Upon signing, the mortal forgets the bartered information, which cannot be restored by any means short of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual; if they restore this knowledge, they lose the boon granted by the contract.

_desc_en: The dragon produces a contract for a single living mortal. This contract can grant a single boon or ability, the extent of which is dependent on the power of the dragon, in exchange for one piece of knowledge the mortal possesses. The mortal must willingly sign their true name to the contract, as well as the knowledge they wish to surrender. Upon signing, the mortal forgets the bartered information, which cannot be restored by any means short of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual; if they restore this knowledge, they lose the boon granted by the contract.
_desc_ko: 용은 단일 살아있는 필멸자를 위한 계약서를 만들어냅니다. 이 계약서는 필멸자가 지닌 지식 한 조각과 교환하여 단일 은혜나 능력을 부여할 수 있으며, 그 범위는 용의 힘에 따라 달라집니다. 필멸자는 자발적으로 자신의 진명과 함께 내놓고자 하는 지식을 계약서에 서명해야 합니다. 서명하는 즉시 필멸자는 거래된 정보를 잊어버리며, 이는 @link[spells.wish] 의식에 준하는 방법이 아니고서는 어떤 수단으로도 되찾을 수 없습니다. 이 지식을 되찾으면 계약으로 부여받은 은혜를 잃습니다.

name: (Nymph Queen) Tied to the Land

description.value:
A nymph queen is intrinsically tied to a specific region. As long as the queen is healthy, the environment is exceptionally resilient, allowing the nymph queen to automatically attempt to counteract any spell that would harm the environment (such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7yWXx3qC4eFNHhxD]{Blight} ritual), using her spell DC with a counteract rank equal to the highest-rank druid spell she can cast.

When the nymph queen becomes physically or psychologically unhealthy, however, her warded region eventually becomes twisted or unhealthy as well. In that case, restoring the nymph queen swiftly heals the entire region.

_desc_en:
A nymph queen is intrinsically tied to a specific region. As long as the queen is healthy, the environment is exceptionally resilient, allowing the nymph queen to automatically attempt to counteract any spell that would harm the environment (such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7yWXx3qC4eFNHhxD]{Blight} ritual), using her spell DC with a counteract rank equal to the highest-rank druid spell she can cast.

When the nymph queen becomes physically or psychologically unhealthy, however, her warded region eventually becomes twisted or unhealthy as well. In that case, restoring the nymph queen swiftly heals the entire region.
_desc_ko:
님프 여왕은 본질적으로 특정 지역과 결속되어 있습니다. 여왕이 건강한 한 그 환경은 유달리 회복력이 강하며, 님프 여왕은 환경에 해를 끼치는 어떤 주문(@link[spells.blight] 등)이든 자신의 주문 DC와 자신이 시전할 수 있는 가장 높은 등급의 드루이드 주문과 동일한 상쇄 등급으로 자동으로 상쇄를 시도할 수 있습니다.

그러나 님프 여왕이 육체적 또는 심리적으로 건강하지 못하게 되면, 그녀가 수호하던 지역 역시 결국 뒤틀리거나 병들게 됩니다. 그런 경우 님프 여왕을 회복시키면 지역 전체가 신속하게 치유됩니다.

name: (Melfesh Monster) Flame Lash

description.value: The Melfesh Monster sprays flaming gas in a @Template[cone|distance:15] or a @Template[line|distance:30]. Creatures in the area take @Damage[4d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|name:Flame Lash|options:area-effect] save). This ability replaces the firelance ranged Strike.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

_desc_en: The Melfesh Monster sprays flaming gas in a @Template[cone|distance:15] or a @Template[line|distance:30]. Creatures in the area take @Damage[4d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|name:Flame Lash|options:area-effect] save). This ability replaces the firelance ranged Strike.
_desc_ko: 멜페시 괴물은 15피트 원뿔 또는 30피트 직선으로 불타는 기체를 뿜습니다. 해당 범위 내의 크리처는 4d6 화염 피해를 입습니다(기본 반사 내성 DC 21). 이 능력은 화염창 원거리 타격을 대체합니다.

name: (Path Maiden) Scorn Fate

description.value: The path maiden targets a creature she can see. The creature must attempt a Will save against the path maiden's spell DC. On a failure, the creature's next roll is cursed. If the result of the roll is a critical success, it becomes a regular success. A success becomes a failure, and a failure becomes a critical failure. That creature is then temporarily immune to Scorn Fate for 24 hours.

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en: The path maiden targets a creature she can see. The creature must attempt a Will save against the path maiden's spell DC. On a failure, the creature's next roll is cursed. If the result of the roll is a critical success, it becomes a regular success. A success becomes a failure, and a failure becomes a critical failure. That creature is then temporarily immune to Scorn Fate for 24 hours.
_desc_ko: 운명길 처녀는 자신이 볼 수 있는 크리처 하나를 목표로 삼습니다. 그 크리처는 운명길 처녀의 주문 DC에 대해 의지 내성을 시도해야 합니다. 실패하면 그 크리처의 다음 굴림이 저주받습니다. 그 굴림의 결과가 대성공이면 일반 성공이 됩니다. 성공은 실패가 되고, 실패는 대실패가 됩니다. 그런 다음 그 크리처는 24시간 동안 운명 조롱에 일시적으로 면역이 됩니다.

name: (Ghoul) Swift Leap

description.value: The ghoul jumps up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

_desc_en: The ghoul jumps up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
_desc_ko: 구울이 자신의 이동력의 절반까지 도약합니다. 이 이동은 반응행동을 유발하지 않습니다.

name: (Divine Warden) Faithful Weapon

description.value: A divine warden always wields its patron deity's favored weapon. If the weapon is a ranged weapon, the divine warden automatically generates new ammunition with each attack. For a divine warden of 4th level or higher, the deity's favored weapon gains the effects of a striking rune while the divine warden wields it; at 12th level, these effects are of a greater striking rune, and at 19th level, they're instead of a major striking rune.

_desc_en: A divine warden always wields its patron deity's favored weapon. If the weapon is a ranged weapon, the divine warden automatically generates new ammunition with each attack. For a divine warden of 4th level or higher, the deity's favored weapon gains the effects of a striking rune while the divine warden wields it; at 12th level, these effects are of a greater striking rune, and at 19th level, they're instead of a major striking rune.
_desc_ko: 신성 수호자는 항상 자신의 수호 신격이 선호하는 무기를 다룹니다. 그 무기가 원거리 무기라면, 신성 수호자는 공격할 때마다 자동으로 새로운 탄약을 생성합니다. 4레벨 이상의 신성 수호자의 경우, 신성 수호자가 그 무기를 다루는 동안 신격이 선호하는 무기는 강타 룬(striking rune)의 효과를 얻습니다. 12레벨에는 이 효과가 상급 강타 룬(greater striking rune)이 되고, 19레벨에는 대신 주요 강타 룬(major striking rune)이 됩니다.

name: (Cryptid, Experimental) Augmented

description.value: An experimental cryptid is partially artificial and designed in a way to specifically prevent biological afflictions and instant death. It gains a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against death effects, disease, and poison.

_desc_en: An experimental cryptid is partially artificial and designed in a way to specifically prevent biological afflictions and instant death. It gains a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against death effects, disease, and poison.
_desc_ko: 실험체 크립티드는 부분적으로 인공적이며, 특히 생물학적 병증과 즉사를 방지하도록 설계되었습니다. 이 크립티드는 죽음 효과, 질병, 독에 대한 내성 굴림에 +2 상황 보너스를 얻습니다.

name: (Resurrection Dragon) Shred Souls

description.value:
Trigger The resurrection dragon ends their turn

Requirements The dragon's Soul Siphoning Breath recharged this turn

Effect Excess void energy spills out from the dragon in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60]. Each living creature in the area must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:|options:area-effect] save with a DC equal to the dragon's Soul Siphoning Breath or gain weakness to void equal to the dragon's resistance to spirit for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure).

_desc_en:
Trigger The resurrection dragon ends their turn

Requirements The dragon's Soul Siphoning Breath recharged this turn

Effect Excess void energy spills out from the dragon in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60]. Each living creature in the area must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:|options:area-effect] save with a DC equal to the dragon's Soul Siphoning Breath or gain weakness to void equal to the dragon's resistance to spirit for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure).
_desc_ko:
발동조건 부활 용이 자신의 턴을 종료합니다

요구조건 용의 영혼 흡수 브레스가 이번 턴에 재충전되었습니다

효과 과잉된 공허 에너지가 용으로부터 60피트 발산으로 쏟아져 나옵니다. 해당 범위 내의 각 크리처는 용의 영혼 흡수 브레스와 동일한 DC로 인내 내성 굴림을 시도해야 하며, 실패하면 1라운드 동안(대실패 시 1분 동안) 용의 영혼 저항력과 동일한 공허 취약성을 얻습니다.

name: (Diabolic Dragon) Diabolic Disguise

description.value: The dragon assumes the form of a specific creature whose soul gem or infernal contract is in their possession or hoard. This has the effects of Change Shape, except the dragon also gains perfunctory knowledge of the creature's personality, social connections, mannerisms, and surface memories, at the GM's discretion. Any knowledge the dragon gains by taking on another creature's form is lost when the dragon dismisses the effect or changes shape again, although nothing prevents them from recording it by other means while transformed.

_desc_en: The dragon assumes the form of a specific creature whose soul gem or infernal contract is in their possession or hoard. This has the effects of Change Shape, except the dragon also gains perfunctory knowledge of the creature's personality, social connections, mannerisms, and surface memories, at the GM's discretion. Any knowledge the dragon gains by taking on another creature's form is lost when the dragon dismisses the effect or changes shape again, although nothing prevents them from recording it by other means while transformed.
_desc_ko: 용은 자신이 소유하거나 보물더미에 지니고 있는 영혼 보석이나 지옥 계약과 관련된 특정 크리처의 형상을 취합니다. 이는 형상 변경(Change Shape)의 효과를 가지지만, 추가로 용은 GM의 재량에 따라 해당 크리처의 성격, 사회적 관계, 습관, 표면적 기억에 대한 피상적인 지식을 얻습니다. 다른 크리처의 형상을 취함으로써 용이 얻은 지식은, 용이 그 효과를 해제하거나 다시 형상을 변경할 때 사라집니다. 다만 변신한 동안 다른 수단으로 그 지식을 기록하는 것은 무엇도 막지 못합니다.

name: (Ravener) Consume Soul

description.value:
Trigger A living creature within 30 feet of the ravener dies

Effect The ravener tears the creature's soul from its body with their maw and gulps it down. The dying creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:|name:Consume Soul] save with the same DC as the ravener's Breath Weapon.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The ravener tears off a small chunk of the creature's soul. If the victim is restored to life, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} in addition to any other side effects of returning to life. The ravener adds a number of Hit Points to their soul ward equal to half the creature's level.

Failure As success, but the creature's soul is ravaged. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} and the ravener adds a number of Hit Points to their soul ward equal to the creature's level.

Critical Failure As failure, but the ravener devours the entire soul. The victim can't be restored to life as long as the ravener exists except via a 10th-rank effect such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YfJTXyVGzLhM6V8U]{Miracle} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish}, and the ravener adds a number of Hit Points to their soul ward equal to twice the creature's level.

_desc_ko:
발동조건 레이브너로부터 30피트 이내의 크리처가 사망합니다

효과 레이브너가 아가리로 크리처의 영혼을 그 몸에서 뜯어내어 삼켜버립니다. 빈사 상태의 크리처는 레이브너의 브레스 무기와 동일한 DC로 인내 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다.

대성공 크리처는 영향을 받지 않습니다.

성공 레이브너가 크리처의 영혼 일부를 조금 뜯어냅니다. 피해자가 다시 살아난다면, 되살아남에 따른 다른 부작용에 더하여 @link[conditions.drained]{1} 상태가 됩니다. 레이브너는 자신의 영혼 방벽(soul ward)에 크리처 레벨의 절반과 동일한 만큼의 HP를 추가합니다.

실패 성공과 같지만, 크리처의 영혼이 유린됩니다. 크리처는 @link[conditions.drained]{3} 상태가 되고, 레이브너는 자신의 영혼 방벽에 크리처 레벨과 동일한 만큼의 HP를 추가합니다.

대실패 실패와 같지만, 레이브너가 영혼 전체를 집어삼킵니다. 피해자는 레이브너가 존재하는 한 @link[spells.miracle]이나 @link[spells.wish]과 같은 10위계 효과를 제외하고는 다시 살아날 수 없으며, 레이브너는 자신의 영혼 방벽에 크리처 레벨의 두 배와 동일한 만큼의 HP를 추가합니다.

name: (Melfesh Monster) Mycelial Tomb

description.value:
Requirements A creature is within 90 feet of the Melfesh Monster and is standing on the ground

Effect Fungal threads burst from the ground. The creature must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:21|name:Mycelial Tomb] save or inhale Melfesh spores that remain in its body for 1 minute, be encased in mycelia, and be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}. The mycelia have Hardness 8 and 16 HP, and the DC to Force them Open is 21. Breaking the mycelia frees the creature and ends the slowed effect. If someone other than the encased creatures breaks the mycelia from the outside, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and takes any damage dealt by the breaking effect in excess of the mycelia's Hit Points. This replaces the Envelop ability.

_desc_ko:
요구조건 어떤 크리처가 멜페시 괴물로부터 90피트 이내에 있으며 땅 위에 서 있습니다

효과 균류 실이 땅에서 솟구쳐 오릅니다. 크리처는 반사 내성 DC 21 굴림에 성공해야 하며, 실패하면 1분 동안 몸속에 남는 멜페시 포자를 들이마시고, 균사에 뒤덮여 @link[conditions.slowed]{2} 상태가 됩니다. 균사는 경도 8과 16 HP를 가지며, 강제로 뜯어내는 DC는 21입니다. 균사를 부수면 크리처가 풀려나고 감속 효과가 종료됩니다. 뒤덮인 크리처가 아닌 다른 누군가가 바깥에서 균사를 부술 경우, 그 크리처는 @link[conditions.stunned]{1} 상태가 되고, 부수는 효과가 균사의 HP를 초과하여 입힌 피해를 받습니다. 이 능력은 감싸기(Envelop) 능력을 대체합니다.

name: (Coral Dragon) Palytoxin

description.value:
Any creature who takes damage from the dragon's jaws, claws, or tail attack, or who Strikes and does damage to the dragon with an unarmed attack, takes @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage (@Damage[2d6[poison]|shortLabel] for ancient and archdragons) and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:|options:inflicts:drained,inflicts:enfeebled] saving throw (DC equal to the DC of the dragon's Hydraulic Breath).

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature's enfeebled condition increases by 1 until the end of its next turn, to a maximum of 3. If the creature is already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} instead.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature's enfeebled condition increases by 2 instead of 1.

_desc_en:
Any creature who takes damage from the dragon's jaws, claws, or tail attack, or who Strikes and does damage to the dragon with an unarmed attack, takes @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage (@Damage[2d6[poison]|shortLabel] for ancient and archdragons) and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:|options:inflicts:drained,inflicts:enfeebled] saving throw (DC equal to the DC of the dragon's Hydraulic Breath).

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature's enfeebled condition increases by 1 until the end of its next turn, to a maximum of 3. If the creature is already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} instead.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature's enfeebled condition increases by 2 instead of 1.
_desc_ko:
용의 턱, 발톱, 또는 꼬리 공격으로 피해를 입은 크리처, 또는 비무장 공격으로 용을 타격하여 피해를 입힌 크리처는 1d6 독 피해(고대 용과 대군주 용의 경우 2d6 독 피해)를 받고 인내 내성 굴림을 시도해야 합니다(DC는 용의 수압 브레스 DC와 동일).

성공 크리처는 영향을 받지 않습니다.

실패 크리처의 쇠약 상태가 다음 턴 종료 시까지 1 증가하며, 최대 3까지 오릅니다. 크리처가 이미 @link[conditions.enfeebled]{3} 상태라면, 대신 @link[conditions.drained]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

대실패 실패와 같지만, 크리처의 쇠약 상태가 1 대신 2 증가합니다.

name: (Coral Dragon) Primal Tide

description.value:
Requirements The dragon is within the bounds of or no more than 25 feet away from their reef

Frequency once per hour

Effect The dragon calls tens of thousands of tiny marine creatures from the crevices in their reef, which pour over a @Template[type:emanation|distance:50] in a clawing, biting, stinging swarm. Every creature in the area that is fully or partially submerged in water must succeed at a @Check[reflex|basic|dc:|options:area-effect] saving throw (DC equal to the DC of the dragon's Hydraulic Breath) or take piercing damage equal to half that dealt by their Hydraulic Breath and an equivalent amount of poison damage. The dragon can specify any number of creatures within the area to be spared. All summoned creatures disperse at the end of the dragon's turn.

Frequency once per hour

The dragon can specify any number of creatures within the area to be spared. All summoned creatures disperse at the end of the dragon's turn.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 용이 자신의 산호초 경계 안에 있거나 그로부터 25피트 이내에 있어야 합니다

빈도 시간당 1회

효과 용이 산호초의 틈새에서 수만 마리의 작은 해양 크리처들을 불러내면, 이들이 50피트 발산 범위 전체에 할퀴고 물고 쏘는 떼로 쏟아집니다. 해당 범위 내에서 물에 완전히 또는 부분적으로 잠긴 모든 크리처는 기본 반사 내성(DC는 용의 수압 숨결 DC와 같음)에 성공해야 하며, 실패 시 용의 수압 숨결이 가하는 피해의 절반에 해당하는 관통 피해와 그와 동일한 양의 독 피해를 입습니다. 용은 범위 내에서 원하는 수만큼의 크리처를 제외하도록 지정할 수 있습니다. 소환된 모든 크리처는 용의 턴이 끝날 때 흩어집니다.

name: (Path Maiden) Corrupting Doubt

description.value: A creature damaged by the path maiden's hand Strike must succeed at a Will save to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure).

publication.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

_desc_en: A creature damaged by the path maiden's hand Strike must succeed at a Will save to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure).
_desc_ko: 운명길 처녀의 손 타격에 피해를 입은 크리처는 의지 내성에 성공해야 하며, 실패 시 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.slowed]{1} 상태가 됩니다(대실패 시 @link[conditions.slowed]{2}).

name: (Visitant) Noxious Breath

description.value:
The visitant exhales sharply, releasing pungent fumes from its lungs in a @Template[cone|distance:15]{15-foot cone}.

Each creature in the area must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:|name:Noxious Breath] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure).

publication.title: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God

_desc_en:
The visitant exhales sharply, releasing pungent fumes from its lungs in a @Template[cone|distance:15]{15-foot cone}.

Each creature in the area must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:|name:Noxious Breath] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure).
_desc_ko:
방문자가 날카롭게 숨을 내쉬며, 폐에서 15피트 원뿔 범위로 자극적인 연기를 방출합니다.

해당 범위 내의 각 크리처는 인내 내성에 성공해야 하며, 실패 시 @link[conditions.sickened]{1} 상태가 됩니다(대실패 시 @link[conditions.sickened]{2}).

name: (Graveknight) Create Grave Squire

description.value:
The graveknight can gift a piece of their armor to another creature, which becomes their grave squire.

The graveknight can communicate telepathically with their squire at any distance, see through the squire's senses, and cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]{Suggestion} as a divine innate spell through the telepathic link at will; the squire treats their degree of success as one step worse.

If the graveknight's main armor is destroyed, the squire's piece expands to cover the squire's body over [[/gmr 1d10 #Days]]{1d10 days}, after which point it becomes the graveknight's new body.

The graveknight can have only one squire at a time and must recover the armor piece to create a new squire.

_desc_en:
The graveknight can gift a piece of their armor to another creature, which becomes their grave squire.

The graveknight can communicate telepathically with their squire at any distance, see through the squire's senses, and cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]{Suggestion} as a divine innate spell through the telepathic link at will; the squire treats their degree of success as one step worse.

If the graveknight's main armor is destroyed, the squire's piece expands to cover the squire's body over [[/gmr 1d10 #Days]]{1d10 days}, after which point it becomes the graveknight's new body.

The graveknight can have only one squire at a time and must recover the armor piece to create a new squire.
_desc_ko:
무덤기사는 자신의 갑옷 한 조각을 다른 크리처에게 선물할 수 있으며, 그 크리처는 무덤기사의 무덤 종자가 됩니다.

무덤기사는 거리에 상관없이 종자와 정신감응으로 소통할 수 있고, 종자의 감각을 통해 볼 수 있으며, 정신감응 연결을 통해 @link[spells.suggestion]를 신성 선천 주문으로 마음껏 시전할 수 있습니다. 종자는 자신의 성공 등급을 한 단계 나쁘게 취급합니다.

무덤기사의 주 갑옷이 파괴되면, 종자의 조각이 1d10일에 걸쳐 종자의 몸 전체를 덮도록 확장되며, 그 이후 그것은 무덤기사의 새로운 몸이 됩니다.

무덤기사는 한 번에 종자를 하나만 둘 수 있으며, 새로운 종자를 만들려면 갑옷 조각을 회수해야 합니다.

name: (Skeleton) Explosive Death

description.value:
When the skeleton is destroyed, its bones shatter and explode.

Adjacent creatures take @Damage[1d6[slashing]] damage per 2 levels (minimum 1d6) with a @Check[reflex|dc:|basic|name:Explosive Death] save against the moderate spell DC for the skeleton's level.

_desc_en:
When the skeleton is destroyed, its bones shatter and explode.

Adjacent creatures take @Damage[1d6[slashing]] damage per 2 levels (minimum 1d6) with a @Check[reflex|dc:|basic|name:Explosive Death] save against the moderate spell DC for the skeleton's level.
_desc_ko:
스켈레톤이 파괴되면, 그 뼈가 산산조각 나며 폭발합니다.

인접한 크리처는 레벨 2당 1d6 참격 피해(최소 1d6)를 입으며, 스켈레톤 레벨의 중급 주문 DC에 대한 기본 반사 내성을 굴립니다.

name: (Conspirator Dragon) Occult Whisperers

description.value: After conversing with a creature for 10 minutes, the dragon can cast one of its occult innate spells targeting the creature by weaving it into the conversation. Spells cast in this way lose the manipulate trait and gain the linguistic trait.

_desc_en: After conversing with a creature for 10 minutes, the dragon can cast one of its occult innate spells targeting the creature by weaving it into the conversation. Spells cast in this way lose the manipulate trait and gain the linguistic trait.
_desc_ko: 어떤 크리처와 10분간 대화를 나눈 뒤, 용은 자신의 비학 선천 주문 중 하나를 대화에 엮어 넣어 그 크리처를 대상으로 시전할 수 있습니다. 이렇게 시전된 주문은 조작 특성을 잃고 언어 특성을 얻습니다.

name: (Martial Artist, Grandmaster) Super Qi Blast

description.value: The grandmaster's body expands as it prepares to exude an unfathomable amount of qi. If the grandmaster's next action is to cast the two-action version of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.oo7YcRC2gcez81PV]{Qi Blast}, the size of the cone increases to 120 feet and the damage increases to 16d6. The grandmaster also becomes one size category larger for the next minute, dealing an additional +9 damage with their melee Strikes. Additionally, the grandmaster is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. This drained condition is cumulative.

The grandmaster also becomes one size category larger for the next minute, dealing an additional +9 damage with their melee Strikes. Additionally, the grandmaster is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. This drained condition is cumulative.
_desc_ko: 종사의 몸이 헤아릴 수 없는 양의 기를 뿜어낼 준비를 하며 팽창합니다. 종사의 다음 행동이 2행동 판본의 @link[spells.qi-blast]을 시전하는 것이라면, 원뿔의 크기가 120피트로 증가하고 피해가 16d6으로 증가합니다. 또한 종사는 다음 1분 동안 한 크기 등급 더 커지며, 근접 타격으로 추가 +9 피해를 가합니다. 추가로, 종사는 영구적으로 @link[conditions.drained]{1} 상태가 됩니다. 이 생명력 고갈 상태는 누적됩니다.

name: (Woodblessed) Luminant Aura

description.value: 20 feet. The volatile planar energy coursing through a woodblessed's veins fills the area with dim light.

_desc_en: 20 feet. The volatile planar energy coursing through a woodblessed's veins fills the area with dim light.
_desc_ko: 20피트. 숲의 축복받은 자의 혈관을 타고 흐르는 불안정한 이계 에너지가 그 범위를 흐릿한 빛으로 채웁니다.

name: (Cryptid, Mutant) Marrowlance

description.value: The mutant cryptid can make wicked spears of bone erupt from its body. The creature can make marrowlance ranged unarmed attacks. Use the highest attack modifier from the creature's highest ranged Strike, as well as the damage from that Strike. If it has no ranged attacks, use moderate accuracy and low damage for the creature's level. Marrowlance unarmed attacks have a range of 60 feet and the versatile S trait.

_desc_en: The mutant cryptid can make wicked spears of bone erupt from its body. The creature can make marrowlance ranged unarmed attacks. Use the highest attack modifier from the creature's highest ranged Strike, as well as the damage from that Strike. If it has no ranged attacks, use moderate accuracy and low damage for the creature's level. Marrowlance unarmed attacks have a range of 60 feet and the versatile S trait.
_desc_ko: 돌연변이 크립티드는 자신의 몸에서 뼈로 된 사악한 창을 돋아나게 할 수 있습니다. 이 크리처는 골수창 근접 무기가 아닌 원거리 공격을 가할 수 있습니다. 이 크리처가 지닌 가장 높은 원거리 타격의 공격 수정치와 그 타격의 피해를 그대로 사용합니다. 원거리 공격이 없다면 해당 크리처 레벨에 맞는 중간 명중과 낮은 피해를 사용합니다. 골수창 비무장 공격은 사거리가 60피트이며 versatile S 특성을 지닙니다.

name: (Ghost) Corporeal Manifestation

description.value:
The ghost loses the incorporeal trait, temporarily increasing its Strength modifier to equal its Charisma modifier. The ghost loses its immunity to precision damage and its resistance to all damage while corporeal.

The ghost can resume being incorporeal by using this action again.

_desc_en:
The ghost loses the incorporeal trait, temporarily increasing its Strength modifier to equal its Charisma modifier. The ghost loses its immunity to precision damage and its resistance to all damage while corporeal.

The ghost can resume being incorporeal by using this action again.
_desc_ko:
유령이 비물질(incorporeal) 특성을 잃고, 근력 수정치를 일시적으로 매력 수정치와 같게 높입니다. 유령은 물질화되어 있는 동안 정밀 피해에 대한 면역과 모든 피해에 대한 저항을 잃습니다.

유령은 이 행동을 다시 사용하여 다시 비물질 상태로 돌아갈 수 있습니다.

name: (Siabrae) Stony Shards

description.value: Tiny shards break off the siabrae's antlers when they attack, lodging in the target's wounds and inflicting a terrible curse. A creature damaged by a siabrae's stone antlers Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:] save against the siabrae's spell DC - 4 or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for [[/r 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} on a failure. If the creature critically fails, or fails while already clumsy 2 or greater, the creature is petrified.

_desc_en: Tiny shards break off the siabrae's antlers when they attack, lodging in the target's wounds and inflicting a terrible curse. A creature damaged by a siabrae's stone antlers Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:] save against the siabrae's spell DC - 4 or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for [[/r 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} on a failure. If the creature critically fails, or fails while already clumsy 2 or greater, the creature is petrified.
_desc_ko: 시아브레가 공격할 때 그 뿔에서 작은 파편이 떨어져 나와 대상의 상처에 박히며 끔찍한 저주를 새깁니다. 시아브레의 돌 뿔 타격에 피해를 입은 크리처는 시아브레의 주문 DC - 4를 상대로 인내 내성에 성공해야 하며, 실패 시 1d4 동안 @link[conditions.clumsy]{2} 상태가 됩니다. 크리처가 대실패하거나, 이미 둔함 2 이상인 상태에서 실패하면 그 크리처는 석화됩니다.

name: (Kuworsys) Rain Blows

description.value:
Requirements Kuworsys is Reared Back

Effect Kuworsys Strikes each creature within its reach, to a maximum of four Strikes (one for each available limb). It can make limb Strikes or weapon Strikes, including with ranged weapons, but can use each weapon only once. Each attack counts toward Kuworsys's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all the attacks.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

_desc_en:
Requirements Kuworsys is Reared Back

Effect Kuworsys Strikes each creature within its reach, to a maximum of four Strikes (one for each available limb). It can make limb Strikes or weapon Strikes, including with ranged weapons, but can use each weapon only once. Each attack counts toward Kuworsys's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all the attacks.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 쿠워시스가 몸을 젖힌(Reared Back) 상태입니다

효과 쿠워시스가 자신의 간격 내에 있는 각 크리처에게 타격을 가하며, 최대 4회(사용 가능한 사지마다 1회)까지 타격할 수 있습니다. 사지 타격이나 무기 타격을 가할 수 있으며 원거리 무기도 포함되지만, 각 무기는 한 번씩만 사용할 수 있습니다. 각 공격은 쿠워시스의 다중 공격 페널티에 포함되지만, 다중 공격 페널티는 모든 공격을 마친 뒤에야 증가합니다.

name: (Beheaded) Whispering

description.value: 30 feet. The beheaded constantly whispers twisted incantations in unknown languages secret and foul. Foes that enter or begin their turn in the area must succeed at a Will save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}. The aura uses the moderate DC for the beheaded's level.

_desc_en: 30 feet. The beheaded constantly whispers twisted incantations in unknown languages secret and foul. Foes that enter or begin their turn in the area must succeed at a Will save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}. The aura uses the moderate DC for the beheaded's level.
_desc_ko: 30피트. 참수된 자는 은밀하고 사악하며 알 수 없는 언어로 뒤틀린 주문을 끊임없이 속삭입니다. 이 범위에 들어오거나 그 안에서 자기 턴을 시작하는 적은 의지 내성에 성공하지 못하면 @link[conditions.stupefied]{1} 상태가 됩니다. 이 오라는 참수된 자의 레벨에 맞는 중간 DC를 사용합니다.

name: (Worm That Walks) Swarm Shape

description.value:
The worm that walks collapses into a shapeless swarm of worms. It drops all held, worn, and carried items.

While discorporated, the worm that walks can't use attack actions and can't cast spells, but it can move through areas small enough for its individual worms to fit without having to Squeeze. It can use the same action to coalesce back into its normal form.

_desc_en:
The worm that walks collapses into a shapeless swarm of worms. It drops all held, worn, and carried items.

While discorporated, the worm that walks can't use attack actions and can't cast spells, but it can move through areas small enough for its individual worms to fit without having to Squeeze. It can use the same action to coalesce back into its normal form.
_desc_ko:
걷는 벌레는 형체 없는 벌레 무리로 무너져 내립니다. 이때 쥐고 있거나 착용하거나 소지한 모든 물품을 떨어뜨립니다.

흩어진 상태에서 걷는 벌레는 공격 행동을 사용할 수 없고 주문을 시전할 수 없지만, 개별 벌레가 통과할 수 있을 만큼 좁은 공간이라면 비집기(Squeeze) 없이 이동할 수 있습니다. 같은 행동을 사용하여 원래 형태로 다시 뭉칠 수 있습니다.

name: (Vampire, True) Drink Blood

description.value:
Requirement A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing creature is within the vampire's reach.

Effect The vampire sinks its fangs into that creature to drink its blood. This requires an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the victim's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions.

The victim is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and the vampire regains HP equal to 10% of its maximum HP, gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to the vampire but increases the victim's drained value by 1, killing the victim when it reaches drained 5. A vampire can also consume blood that's been emptied into a vessel for sustenance, but it gains no HP from doing so.

A victim's drained condition decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a @Check[medicine|dc:20|name:Blood Transfusion] check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drain by 1 after 10 minutes.

_desc_en:
Requirement A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing creature is within the vampire's reach.

Effect The vampire sinks its fangs into that creature to drink its blood. This requires an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the victim's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions.

The victim is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and the vampire regains HP equal to 10% of its maximum HP, gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to the vampire but increases the victim's drained value by 1, killing the victim when it reaches drained 5. A vampire can also consume blood that's been emptied into a vessel for sustenance, but it gains no HP from doing so.

A victim's drained condition decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a @Check[medicine|dc:20|name:Blood Transfusion] check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drain by 1 after 10 minutes.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 @link[conditions.grabbed], @link[conditions.paralyzed], @link[conditions.restrained], @link[conditions.unconscious] 상태이거나 자발적으로 응하는 크리처가 뱀파이어의 간격 내에 있습니다.

효과 뱀파이어가 그 크리처에게 송곳니를 박아 피를 빨아들입니다. 대상이 붙잡힘 상태라면 대상의 인내 DC를 상대로 운동 판정 판정이 필요하며, 그 외의 상태 중 하나라면 자동으로 성공합니다.

대상은 @link[conditions.drained]{2} 상태가 되고, 뱀파이어는 자신의 최대 HP의 10%에 해당하는 HP를 회복하며 넘치는 HP는 임시 HP로 얻습니다. 이미 생명력 고갈 상태인 크리처에게서 흡혈하면 뱀파이어는 HP를 전혀 회복하지 못하지만 대상의 생명력 고갈 수치가 1 증가하며, 그 수치가 5에 이르면 대상은 사망합니다. 뱀파이어는 그릇에 담긴 피를 마셔 자양분으로 삼을 수도 있으나, 그로부터는 HP를 얻지 못합니다.

대상의 생명력 고갈 상태는 매주 1씩 감소합니다. DC 20 의학 판정 판정과 충분한 양의 피 또는 헌혈자가 필요한 수혈은 10분 후 생명력 고갈을 1 줄여줍니다.

name: (Secret Society) Skill Savvy

description.value: The secret society member has a few tricks most others do not. They gain two of the following skill feats: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.B6HbYsLBWb1RR6Fx]{Charming Liar}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JtjnFsOToBLnSRO9]{Courtly Graces}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WeQGWvlWdeLeOlCN]{Glean Contents}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4RjDxgvNXNl5GG9d]{Hobnobber}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HEBXaS656MZTiWFu]{Lengthy Diversion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Dvz54d6aPhjsmUux]{Lie to Me}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ar2DUlvDK4LDcH9J]{Quick Coercion}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.X2jGFfLU5qI5XVot]{Streetwise}. If they are at least 2nd level, they can also choose from among the following: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.uF0ATN2Zw1Q67ew2]{Discreet Inquiry}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.cc8O47KFsODReoBe]{Glad-Hand}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.6vnbC90UQ3I57RrQ]{Lasting Coercion}. If they are at least 7th level, they can also choose @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KIK2Eza9TK47MEb2]{Shameless Request} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RiuZT3H4QZIIEQXJ]{Slippery Secrets}.

_desc_en: The secret society member has a few tricks most others do not. They gain two of the following skill feats: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.B6HbYsLBWb1RR6Fx]{Charming Liar}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.JtjnFsOToBLnSRO9]{Courtly Graces}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.WeQGWvlWdeLeOlCN]{Glean Contents}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.4RjDxgvNXNl5GG9d]{Hobnobber}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HEBXaS656MZTiWFu]{Lengthy Diversion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Dvz54d6aPhjsmUux]{Lie to Me}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ar2DUlvDK4LDcH9J]{Quick Coercion}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.X2jGFfLU5qI5XVot]{Streetwise}. If they are at least 2nd level, they can also choose from among the following: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.uF0ATN2Zw1Q67ew2]{Discreet Inquiry}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.cc8O47KFsODReoBe]{Glad-Hand}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.6vnbC90UQ3I57RrQ]{Lasting Coercion}. If they are at least 7th level, they can also choose @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KIK2Eza9TK47MEb2]{Shameless Request} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.RiuZT3H4QZIIEQXJ]{Slippery Secrets}.
_desc_ko: 비밀 결사 조직원은 대부분의 다른 이들이 갖지 못한 몇 가지 재간을 지닙니다. 이들은 다음 기술 재주 중 두 가지를 얻습니다: @link[feats.charming-liar], @link[feats.courtly-graces], @link[feats.glean-contents], @link[feats.hobnobber], @link[feats.lengthy-diversion], @link[feats.lie-to-me], @link[feats.quick-coercion], @link[feats.streetwise]. 최소 2레벨이라면 다음 중에서도 고를 수 있습니다: @link[feats.discreet-inquiry], @link[feats.glad-hand], @link[feats.lasting-coercion]. 최소 7레벨이라면 @link[feats.shameless-request]이나 @link[feats.slippery-secrets]도 고를 수 있습니다.

name: (Ravener) Vicious Criticals

description.value:
The ravener treats an attack roll as a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20, as long as the attack roll was a success. Additionally, whenever the ravener makes a critical hit with one of their Strikes, the target must succeed on a @Check[fortitude|dc:|name:Vicious Criticals] save or gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} condition. If the target already has a drained value of greater than 0, their drained value instead increases by 1, to a maximum of drained 4.

Whenever the ravener applies drain to a creature in this way, their soul ward gains 5 Hit Points.

_desc_en:
The ravener treats an attack roll as a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20, as long as the attack roll was a success. Additionally, whenever the ravener makes a critical hit with one of their Strikes, the target must succeed on a @Check[fortitude|dc:|name:Vicious Criticals] save or gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} condition. If the target already has a drained value of greater than 0, their drained value instead increases by 1, to a maximum of drained 4.

Whenever the ravener applies drain to a creature in this way, their soul ward gains 5 Hit Points.
_desc_ko:
레이브너는 명중 굴림이 성공한 경우, 19나 20이 나오면 그 명중 굴림을 치명타로 취급합니다. 또한 레이브너가 자신의 타격 중 하나로 치명타를 낼 때마다, 대상은 인내 내성(DC는 흉악한 치명타)에 성공하지 못하면 @link[conditions.drained]{1} 상태가 됩니다. 대상이 이미 0보다 큰 생명력 고갈 수치를 가지고 있다면, 대신 생명력 고갈 수치가 1 증가하며 최대 생명력 고갈 4까지 오릅니다.

레이브너가 이런 방식으로 어떤 크리처에게 생명력 고갈을 적용할 때마다, 그들의 영혼 방벽이 5 HP를 얻습니다.

name: (Cryptid, Rumored) Stalk

description.value:
Requirements The rumored cryptid is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}

Effect The rumored cryptid swiftly stalks prey from hiding. It Strides, then Strikes.

_desc_en:
Requirements The rumored cryptid is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}

Effect The rumored cryptid swiftly stalks prey from hiding. It Strides, then Strikes.
_desc_ko:
요구조건 소문의 크립티드가 @link[conditions.undetected] 상태입니다

효과 소문의 크립티드가 숨은 채로 먹잇감에게 재빠르게 몰래 접근합니다. 이동한 다음 타격합니다.

name: (Lich) Paralyzing Touch

description.value:
A creature damaged by the lich's hand Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:] save against the lich's spell DC-4.

The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round on a failure. On a critical failure, the creature is paralyzed permanently, falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, and seems dead. A @Check[medicine|dc:25|name:Diagnose Paralysis|traits:arcane,curse,necromancy|overrideTraits:true] check reveals the victim is alive.

_desc_en:
A creature damaged by the lich's hand Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:] save against the lich's spell DC-4.

The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round on a failure. On a critical failure, the creature is paralyzed permanently, falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, and seems dead. A @Check[medicine|dc:25|name:Diagnose Paralysis|traits:arcane,curse,necromancy|overrideTraits:true] check reveals the victim is alive.
_desc_ko:
리치의 손 타격으로 피해를 입은 크리처는 리치의 주문 DC-4에 대한 인내 내성에 성공해야 합니다.

실패 시 그 크리처는 1라운드 동안 @link[conditions.paralyzed] 상태가 됩니다. 대실패 시, 그 크리처는 영구히 마비되고 @link[conditions.prone] 상태가 되며 죽은 것처럼 보입니다. 의술 DC 25(마비 진단) 판정에 성공하면 피해자가 살아있음을 알아냅니다.

name: (Ulgrem-Axaan) Crocodile Tears

description.value: Ulgrem-Axaan can mimic the sound of a wounded prey animal by attempting a Deception check to Lie. It has a +4 circumstance bonus to this check.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

_desc_en: Ulgrem-Axaan can mimic the sound of a wounded prey animal by attempting a Deception check to Lie. It has a +4 circumstance bonus to this check.
_desc_ko: 울그렘-악사안은 거짓말을 하기 위한 기만 판정을 시도해 부상당한 먹잇감 동물의 소리를 흉내 낼 수 있습니다. 이 판정에 +4 상황 보너스를 받습니다.

name: (Coven) Locate Coven

description.value: The creature selects one other member of their coven; they can sense the location and conditions of that coven member regardless of distance, even if they're on different planes of existence.

_desc_en: The creature selects one other member of their coven; they can sense the location and conditions of that coven member regardless of distance, even if they're on different planes of existence.
_desc_ko: 이 크리처는 자기 마녀단의 다른 구성원 하나를 선택합니다. 거리에 상관없이, 심지어 서로 다른 존재의 세계에 있더라도 그 마녀단 구성원의 위치와 상태를 감지할 수 있습니다.

name: (Conspirator Dragon) Mental Feedback

description.value:
Trigger A creature uses a magical mental effect against the dragon

Effect The dragon uses their mental blast against the triggering creature. On a critical hit, the mental effect is disrupted.

_desc_en:
Trigger A creature uses a magical mental effect against the dragon

Effect The dragon uses their mental blast against the triggering creature. On a critical hit, the mental effect is disrupted.
_desc_ko:
발동조건 어떤 크리처가 용을 상대로 마법적 정신 효과를 사용합니다

효과 용이 발동을 유발한 크리처를 상대로 자신의 정신 방출을 사용합니다. 치명타 시, 그 정신 효과가 방해됩니다.

name: (Swarm Strider) Squirming Embrace

description.value: The swarm strider Strides. If they end their movement sharing a space with a creature, they deal @Damage[1d6[piercing]] damage to the creature, with a basic Reflex save. The save DC is the high spell DC for the swarm strider's level. The damage increases by 1d6 at 4th level and every 3 levels thereafter. The swarm strider can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Striding if they have the corresponding movement type.

_desc_en: The swarm strider Strides. If they end their movement sharing a space with a creature, they deal @Damage[1d6[piercing]] damage to the creature, with a basic Reflex save. The save DC is the high spell DC for the swarm strider's level. The damage increases by 1d6 at 4th level and every 3 levels thereafter. The swarm strider can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Striding if they have the corresponding movement type.
_desc_ko: 무리 활보자가 이동합니다. 만약 이동을 마쳤을 때 어떤 크리처와 같은 칸을 공유하고 있다면, 그 크리처에게 1d6 관통 피해를 주며 기본 반사 내성이 적용됩니다. 내성 DC는 무리 활보자의 레벨에 해당하는 높은 주문 DC입니다. 피해는 4레벨에 1d6 증가하고 이후 3레벨마다 증가합니다. 무리 활보자는 해당하는 이동 방식을 가지고 있다면 이동 대신 굴착, 등반, 비행, 또는 수영을 할 수 있습니다.

name: (Secret Society) Shibboleth

description.value: Secret society members can communicate with other members of their secret society using coded language that seems innocuous enough to go unnoticed by most onlookers. A creature specifically gauging the conversation, such as with [[/act sense-motive]], can attempt a secret Perception check against the secret society member's Deception DC to notice something secret has been communicated, after which they can attempt a Society check against the same DC. On a success, they discover the rough topic of the message; on a critical success, they discover the exact message.

_desc_en: Secret society members can communicate with other members of their secret society using coded language that seems innocuous enough to go unnoticed by most onlookers. A creature specifically gauging the conversation, such as with [[/act sense-motive]], can attempt a secret Perception check against the secret society member's Deception DC to notice something secret has been communicated, after which they can attempt a Society check against the same DC. On a success, they discover the rough topic of the message; on a critical success, they discover the exact message.
_desc_ko: 비밀 결사 구성원들은 대부분의 구경꾼에게는 눈에 띄지 않을 만큼 무해해 보이는 암호화된 언어를 사용해 자기 비밀 결사의 다른 구성원들과 의사소통할 수 있습니다. 의도 파악처럼 특별히 그 대화를 살피는 크리처는 비밀 결사 구성원의 기만 DC에 대한 비밀 관찰 판정을 시도해 무언가 은밀한 내용이 전달되었음을 알아챌 수 있으며, 그 후 같은 DC에 대한 사회 판정을 시도할 수 있습니다. 성공 시, 그 메시지의 대략적인 주제를 알아냅니다. 대성공 시, 정확한 메시지를 알아냅니다.

name: (Mana Wastes Mutant) Caustic Pustules

description.value: Whenever the mutant takes piercing or slashing damage, creatures adjacent to the mutant take @Damage[1d6[acid]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:|basic]). The damage increases to 2d6 if the mutant is at least 8th level and 3d6 if the mutant is at least 15th level.

_desc_en: Whenever the mutant takes piercing or slashing damage, creatures adjacent to the mutant take @Damage[1d6[acid]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:|basic]). The damage increases to 2d6 if the mutant is at least 8th level and 3d6 if the mutant is at least 15th level.
_desc_ko: 변종이 관통 또는 참격 피해를 입을 때마다, 변종에 인접한 크리처들은 1d6 산성 피해를 입습니다(기본 반사 내성). 이 피해는 변종이 8레벨 이상이면 2d6으로, 15레벨 이상이면 3d6으로 증가합니다.

name: (Skeleton) Crumbling Bones

description.value: The skeleton is made from crumbling bones that drift in clouds of dust. The skeleton has a fly Speed of 20 but it must end its turn within no more than 5 feet off the ground, or it falls, taking damage as normal. In addition, the skeleton can move through any space that's large enough for its skull to fit through.

_desc_en: The skeleton is made from crumbling bones that drift in clouds of dust. The skeleton has a fly Speed of 20 but it must end its turn within no more than 5 feet off the ground, or it falls, taking damage as normal. In addition, the skeleton can move through any space that's large enough for its skull to fit through.
_desc_ko: 이 해골은 먼지 구름 속을 떠도는 부스러지는 뼈로 이루어져 있습니다. 해골은 비행 속도 20을 가지지만, 반드시 지면에서 5피트를 넘지 않는 높이에서 자신의 턴을 끝내야 하며, 그렇지 못하면 추락하여 평소대로 피해를 입습니다. 또한 해골은 자신의 두개골이 통과할 만큼 큰 공간이라면 어디든 이동하여 지나갈 수 있습니다.

name: (Failed Prophet) Greedy Grab

description.value:
Requirements The failed prophet's last action was a successful fist Strike that dealt damage

Effect The failed prophet attempts a Thievery check against the target's Reflex DC. On a success, the failed prophet pilfers coins and gems from the target with a total value as indicated in the table, to a maximum of what the target is carrying. Valuables in unlocked containers on the target's person can be taken just as easily as those carried. On a critical success, the failed prophet steals double that amount. The failed prophet gains a number of temporary Hit Points equal to the value stolen that last for 1 minute.

_desc_ko:
요구조건 타락한 예언자의 마지막 행동이 피해를 입힌 성공한 주먹 타격이어야 합니다

효과 타락한 예언자는 대상의 반사 DC를 상대로 손속임 판정을 시도합니다. 성공하면, 타락한 예언자는 아래 표에 표시된 총 가치만큼의 동전과 보석을 대상에게서 슬쩍하며, 그 상한은 대상이 지니고 있는 양까지입니다. 대상의 몸에 지닌 잠기지 않은 용기 안의 귀중품도 몸에 지닌 것만큼 손쉽게 빼낼 수 있습니다. 대성공하면, 타락한 예언자는 그 두 배를 훔칩니다. 타락한 예언자는 훔친 가치와 동일한 수의 임시 HP를 얻으며, 이는 1분간 지속됩니다.

name: (Martial Artist) Kiai!

description.value:
Frequency once per turn

Requirements The martial student attempts a Strike

Effect The martial student shouts to startle their adversary. If the Strike is successful, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

_desc_en:
Frequency once per turn

Requirements The martial student attempts a Strike

Effect The martial student shouts to startle their adversary. If the Strike is successful, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.
_desc_ko:
빈도 턴당 1회

요구조건 무술 수련자가 타격을 시도합니다

효과 무술 수련자가 적을 놀라게 하려고 고함을 지릅니다. 타격이 성공하면, 대상은 @link[conditions.frightened]{1} 상태가 됩니다.

name: (Mana Wastes Mutant) Too Many Eyes

description.value: Countless eyes sprout on the mutant's skin. They gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.9qV49KjZujZnSp6w]{All-Around Vision}.

_desc_en: Countless eyes sprout on the mutant's skin. They gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.9qV49KjZujZnSp6w]{All-Around Vision}.
_desc_ko: 변종의 피부에 셀 수 없이 많은 눈이 돋아납니다. 이들은 @link[actions.all-around-vision]를 얻습니다.

name: (Mythic) Hazard Immunity

description.value: A mythic ambusher never triggers the reactions of hazards in its own lair and is immune to the negative consequences of damaging area effects created by hazards in its lair.

_desc_en: A mythic ambusher never triggers the reactions of hazards in its own lair and is immune to the negative consequences of damaging area effects created by hazards in its lair.
_desc_ko: 신화적 매복자는 자신의 소굴에 있는 위험 요소의 반응행동을 결코 촉발하지 않으며, 자신의 소굴에 있는 위험 요소가 만들어낸 피해를 주는 지역 효과의 부정적 결과에 면역입니다.

name: (Omen Dragon) Forewarned and Forearmed

description.value:
At the start of the day, a dragon can perform a 10-minute ritual to prepare themself for any fights they might have in the day ahead. The dragon chooses one of the following effects, which last for 24 hours.

  • Assured Fate (fortune) When the omen dragon rolls initiative, instead of rolling, they can choose to have a result equal to 13 + their initiative modifier.

    @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.ggqCmAH0a7cmAdA3]{Effect: Assured Fate}

  • Instinctive Challenge During an encounter, the fortune dragon gains an additional reaction at the start of their turn that can be used only for Challenge Fate.

_desc_en:
At the start of the day, a dragon can perform a 10-minute ritual to prepare themself for any fights they might have in the day ahead. The dragon chooses one of the following effects, which last for 24 hours.

  • Assured Fate (fortune) When the omen dragon rolls initiative, instead of rolling, they can choose to have a result equal to 13 + their initiative modifier.

    @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.ggqCmAH0a7cmAdA3]{Effect: Assured Fate}

  • Instinctive Challenge During an encounter, the fortune dragon gains an additional reaction at the start of their turn that can be used only for Challenge Fate.
_desc_ko:
하루가 시작될 때, 용은 10분짜리 의식을 수행하여 그날 벌어질 수 있는 어떤 전투에도 대비할 수 있습니다. 용은 다음 효과 중 하나를 선택하며, 그 효과는 24시간 동안 지속됩니다.

  • 확정된 운명 (행운) 전조의 용은 우선권을 굴릴 때, 굴리는 대신 13 + 자신의 우선권 수정치와 동일한 결과를 선택할 수 있습니다.

  • 본능적 도전 조우 중, 행운의 용은 자신의 턴이 시작될 때 오직 운명 도전에만 사용할 수 있는 추가 반응행동을 하나 얻습니다.

name: (Graveknight) Rejuvenation

description.value:
When a graveknight is destroyed, their armor rebuilds their body over the course of [[/gmr 1d10]] days—or more quickly if the armor is worn by a living host. If the body is destroyed before then, the process restarts.

A graveknight can only be permanently destroyed by obliterating their armor (such as with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}), transporting it to the Forge of Creation, or throwing it into the heart of a volcano.

_desc_en:
When a graveknight is destroyed, their armor rebuilds their body over the course of [[/gmr 1d10]] days—or more quickly if the armor is worn by a living host. If the body is destroyed before then, the process restarts.

A graveknight can only be permanently destroyed by obliterating their armor (such as with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}), transporting it to the Forge of Creation, or throwing it into the heart of a volcano.
_desc_ko:
묘지기사가 파괴되면, 그들의 갑옷이 1d10일에 걸쳐 그들의 몸을 다시 만들어냅니다. 갑옷을 살아 있는 숙주가 착용하고 있다면 더 빠르게 진행됩니다. 그 전에 몸이 다시 파괴되면, 과정은 처음부터 다시 시작됩니다.

묘지기사는 오직 그들의 갑옷을 완전히 소멸시키거나(@link[spells.disintegrate] 등으로), 창조의 대장간으로 옮기거나, 화산의 중심부에 던져 넣어야만 영구적으로 파괴할 수 있습니다.

name: (Mythic) Mythic Mobility

description.value: A mythic striker benefits from high mobility and is difficult to pin down. It always uses the extreme skill value for a creature of its level as its Acrobatics modifier.

_desc_en: A mythic striker benefits from high mobility and is difficult to pin down. It always uses the extreme skill value for a creature of its level as its Acrobatics modifier.
_desc_ko: 신화적 타격자는 높은 기동성의 이점을 누리며 꼼짝 못 하게 붙잡기가 어렵습니다. 자신의 곡예 수정치로는 언제나 자기 레벨의 크리처에 해당하는 극한 기술 값을 사용합니다.

name: (Vampire, True) Change Shape

description.value:
The vampire transforms into one of its animal forms or back into its normal form. Most vampires can turn into a bat, but some can turn into a different creature, such as a rat or a wolf.

Use the options in the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NzXpEzcZAjuDTZjK]{Aerial Form} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form} spells as guidelines.

  • Bat The vampire changes into a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.2mg30nJR6P3HJDSd]{Bat Swarm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.xnpuGO8jEMba9wy5]{Giant Bat}. They gain echolocation 40 feet, a land Speed of 20 feet and a fly Speed of 30 feet, and a fangs Strike with the same attack bonus as their highest melee attack. These fangs deal the same amount of damage as the vampire's claws, but deal piercing damage rather than slashing damage.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

_desc_en:

Use the options in the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NzXpEzcZAjuDTZjK]{Aerial Form} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form} spells as guidelines.

  • Bat The vampire changes into a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.2mg30nJR6P3HJDSd]{Bat Swarm} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.xnpuGO8jEMba9wy5]{Giant Bat}.
